mounts.name: Riding training
mounts.how: Apprentice Riding is learned at level 40 for 100g from your race's riding trainer and includes one basic racial mount (+60%). Journeyman Riding is learned at level 60 for 1,000g and allows swift mounts (+100%). Honored with your home faction gives 10% off training and racial mounts; the Bartering Legacy talent gives up to a further 10% off mounts (not training). Other races' mounts need Exalted with that race.
mounts.where: Your race's riding trainer (e.g. Randal Hunter, Elwynn Forest; Kildar, Orgrimmar; Genn Fairweather, Zephras Isle)

gear.how: drops from trash (probable, not yet seen)

gear.name: Alcaz Willcrusher
gear.how: drops from an unknown source in Alcaz Prison (probable, not yet seen)

gear.name: Defias Enforcer's Legguards
gear.classes: Leather wearers (Rogue, Druid; also Hunter/Shaman early)
gear.how: drops from an unknown source in Alcaz Prison (probable, not yet seen)

gear.name: Withering Grips
gear.classes: Leather wearers (Rogue, Druid; also Hunter/Shaman early)

gear.name: Torch of Light
gear.how: datamined from client; boss not confirmed (raid unlocks 9 Dec 2026)

gear.name: Sonya's Darkened Glaive
gear.how: datamined from client; boss not confirmed (raid unlocks 9 Dec 2026)

gear.name: Soulrip Staff
gear.how: datamined; boss unconfirmed (themed after Kathris the Haunted) (raid unlocks 9 Dec 2026)

gear.name: Yjn'raathma, Sword of the Still Wind
Wild King Crown
gear.how: datamined; presumed from The Wild King, unconfirmed (raid unlocks 9 Dec 2026)

quests.name: Zephras Isle storyline (Skyborne starting story)
steps: Coming of Age: receive an Ancient Heirloom, hand in to Rorian the Dayseeker
Harmony in Balance / Infestation Investigation / The Cirrusfly Queen in Thendal Grove
Elemental Unrest and Agitators: deal with rolling winds and Al'Aketh converts to the north
Return to Rorian, then Aetheen of the Gales; Foul Matriarch kills the bear matriarch Urs'anah
The Next Step: travel to Shen'dar Village (Al'Aketh Thugs, The Adventurer on the way)
Faction intro: The Windshapers (Horde) or The High Order (Alliance)
Infiltrate the Al'Aketh cult at Falaath Village (Among the Faithful), then fight it in the Shen'dar Highlands
Go to Valanaar, the Skyborne capital, and meet your faction leader
Faction branch in Shadowgale Forest (e.g. A Firm Response for Windshapers)
What Comes Next: once the cult is beaten, leave the isle by skycutter
quests.reward: Quest XP, High Order or Windshapers reputation, early class rewards
quests.notes: Both factions share the zone but are phased apart. The Skyborne made a pact with air elementals after the War of the Ancients; the Al'Aketh cult, devoted to Al'Akir, threatens the isle. Faction split at level 4: Reading the Leylines (Alliance) or The Gift of Skysight (Horde). The final chapter quest names were not captured by sources.

quests.name: What Comes Next (leaving Zephras Isle)
steps: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale (Alliance) or Ayessa Dawnsinger (Horde) when ready to leave
quests.reward: XP, +25 High Order or Windshapers reputation
quests.notes: Alliance skycutters go to Dalaran (set up by Ansirem). Horde skycutters go to Mulgore, home of the Earthen Ring (set up by Muln).

quests.name: High Order / Windshapers reputation (Galestrider access)
quests.startsAt: Zephras Isle questing; cloth turn-ins at Belanaa Windveil (Dalaran) or Oura Stormspinner (Mulgore)
steps: Quest on Zephras Isle for High Order (Alliance) or Windshapers (Horde) reputation
Turn in cloth to the faction's representative to keep raising reputation
At Exalted, non-Skyborne races can buy Galestriders at Fairweather Stables
quests.reward: Galestrider mounts (Umber, Stormy, Empyrean and Swift versions); 5-20% discount on mounts and riding from Friendly to Exalted
quests.notes: Skyborne buy Galestriders with no quest. The reputation is mainly how other races get them.

quests.name: The Great Outdoors (Camping unlock)
quests.startsAt: Just outside each starting town: Sam Sarsaparilla (Elwynn), Eric Brighthammer (Dun Morogh), Lyreena Duskblade (Teldrassil), Brakk (Durotar), Eleanor Shackleton (Tirisfal), Kaga Wildhoof (Mulgore), Raan Wildwind (Zephras Isle)
steps: Sit at a campfire (X or /sit) until the 60-second Welcoming Campfire timer finishes
Follow-up Camping 101 quests: learn Cooking from the local trainer, which lets you build a Basic Campfire from Simple Wood and Flint and Tinder
quests.reward: Unlocks Camping and the campfire rest buff; leads to Camping 101 quests
quests.notes: Some players found the sit objective stuck at 0/1; sitting and then typing /sit fixed it for some.

quests.name: Camping 101 (profession camp quests)
quests.startsAt: Same camping NPCs as The Great Outdoors; profession quests from town campfire NPCs
steps: Camping 101: Cooking - learn Cooking from the town trainer
Other Camping 101 quests for First Aid, Fishing, Herbalism and Skinning
When you learn a profession, a campfire NPC asks you to raise it to 20
quests.reward: Ability to craft that profession's Tier 1 camp item
quests.notes: Wiki lists Camping 101: Cooking, First Aid, Fishing, Herbalism and Skinning.

quests.name: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood (legendary)
quests.reward: Taldramir, the Whispering Wood - legendary two-handed staff
quests.notes: Revealed by Blizzard on 4-5 Nov 2026 (made with Weta Workshop). The class, stats and how to get it are not announced. Wowhead reports a druid theme. A legendary questline is scheduled for Spring 2027 and is tied to the new raids. Datamined clues are unconfirmed. Blizzard plans an earnable legendary for every class or spec over time.

quests.name: Onyxia's Lair attunement - Alliance (Drakefire Amulet)
steps: The True Masters chain: Lakeshire (Magistrate Solomon), Stormwind (Bolvar, Lady Katrana Prestor), back to Marshal Maxwell
Marshal Windsor: find him jailed in Blackrock Depths
Abandoned Hope, then A Crumpled Up Note (dropped by BRD mobs)
A Shred of Hope: kill Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge
Jail Break! escort out of BRD
Stormwind Rendezvous and The Great Masquerade in Stormwind
The Dragon's Eye: Haleh in Winterspring
Drakefire Amulet: kill General Drakkisath in UBRS for the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
quests.reward: Drakefire Amulet (must be in bags to enter Onyxia's Lair)
quests.notes: Onyxia's Lair (40 players) opens 9 Dec 2026. The attunement is per character, not account-wide, at least at first.

quests.name: Onyxia's Lair attunement - Horde (Drakefire Amulet)
steps: For the Horde!, What the Wind Carries, The Champion of the Horde (Thrall and Eitrigg in Orgrimmar)
The Testament of Rexxar (Desolace), Oculus Illusions (Myranda the Hag, Western Plaguelands)
The Test of Skulls x4: four elite dragons in four zones
Blood of the Black Dragon Champion: kill Drakkisath in UBRS and return to Rexxar
quests.notes: 15 quests. Onyxia's Lair opens 9 Dec 2026.

quests.name: Barrow Deeps access
quests.startsAt: Entrances in Mount Hyjal, Winterspring and Blackmaw Hold
quests.notes: Blizzard's raid overview lists no attunement for Barrow Deeps; only Onyxia needs one. Opens 9 Dec 2026, level 60.

quests.name: Hyjal Summit access
quests.startsAt: Summit of Mount Hyjal, near Nordrassil
quests.notes: No attunement is listed by Blizzard. Old client records labelled 'Hyjal Attunement' mention Distilled Demonic Essence, Gol'gere and Leyara, but their purpose is unconfirmed. Opens 9 Dec 2026.

quests.name: City of Dalaran key - Horde (Dalaran Sewer Key)
quests.startsAt: Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill (Hillsbrad Foothills)
steps: Prison Break In: collect four Bloodstone pieces at Lordamere Internment Camp
Key to the City: get the Grimy Key from a Warden's Footlocker
Dalaran Patrols: kill Dalaran Summoners and Elemental Slaves at the Old Dalaran ruins
Blood in the Streets: speak to the Image of Archmage Modera at the sewer entrance
Heart of Disruption (inside the dungeon): Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage
quests.reward: Dalaran Sewer Key (one group member needs it)
quests.notes: City of Dalaran is a new dungeon in Alterac Mountains, about levels 28-33. Keeper Bel'varil in Tarren Mill has related side quests (Stone Tokens, Bracers of Binding).

quests.name: City of Dalaran key - Alliance (An Alarming Request)
quests.startsAt: Emissary Jaques, Southshore town hall (Hillsbrad Foothills)
steps: An Alarming Request: report to the Image of Archmage Modera at the sewer gate
Heart of Disruption: take an Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage
Friend of the Kirin Tor: take the mote to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel
quests.reward: Dalaran Sewer Key (granted while Heart of Disruption is in your log); Kirin Tor reputation
quests.notes: Other Alliance Dalaran quests: Power Overwhelming and A Green Sample (from Stormwind), Starving Arcane (from Modera).

quests.name: Seal of Ascension (UBRS key)
quests.startsAt: Vaelan, near the Lower Blackrock Spire entrance
steps: Loot the Unadorned Seal of Ascension from LBRS trash
Collect gemstones from Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone and Overlord Wyrmthalak
Take the Unforged Seal to Emberstrife in the Wyrmbog (Dustwallow Marsh) and defeat him
quests.notes: Whether the UBRS door still needs the seal in Forever is unconfirmed.

quests.name: Dark Iron Legacy (Shadowforge Key)
quests.startsAt: Ghost of Franclorn Forgewright, Molten Span (Blackrock Mountain)
steps: Kill Fineous Darkvire in BRD for Ironfel
Place Ironfel on Franclorn's statue at the Shrine of Thaurissan

quests.name: The Key to Scholomance
quests.startsAt: Chillwind Camp (Alliance) or The Bulwark (Horde), Western Plaguelands
quests.notes: The final quest requires level 55.

quests.name: Legends of Maraudon / The Scepter of Celebras
steps: Collect the two scepter parts in Maraudon
Free Celebras the Redeemed, who forges the scepter
quests.reward: Scepter of Celebras (shortcut into inner Maraudon)

quests.name: Attunement to the Core (Molten Core)
steps: Get a Core Fragment near the Molten Core portal in BRD and bring it to Lothos
quests.reward: Attunement to Molten Core (teleport via Lothos)
quests.notes: Classic quest. Blizzard has not confirmed Molten Core in Forever; its launch roadmap names only Onyxia, Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit, plus unnamed later raids.

quests.name: Mount Hyjal restoration story
quests.startsAt: Darkwhisper Gorge (Winterspring); Summit of Eternity hub
steps: Pass the druidic wards through Darkwhisper Gorge into Hyjal
Help the Cenarion Circle and Druids of the Talon heal the land after Archimonde's death
Conflict with the Wild King (later a Hyjal Summit boss)
A chain started by a Curious Crow leads to warlock activity around the Wild King
quests.reward: Guardians of Hyjal and Barkskin Burrow reputation
quests.notes: The road into Hyjal is open for the first time since the Third War. Horde and Alliance share the mountain uneasily. Exact quest names and order were largely unpublished at the time of research.

quests.name: To Have Loved and Lost (Hyjal druid camp)
steps: Rebuild a druid camp; later phases swap its basic objects for upgraded ones
quests.notes: Named in the client and treated as high-confidence by the source. Steps and rewards are not detailed.

quests.name: Guardians of Hyjal reputation (Friendly Advice)
quests.startsAt: Summit of Eternity, Mount Hyjal (Aisarra Nightmeadow, Keeper of Knowledge)
steps: Reach Friendly and complete Friendly Advice to buy high-level profession patterns
quests.reward: Raid-tier profession patterns (Manaflare, Conviction, Demonheart, Grovekeeper); Rousing Seed Pod (raises the Artisan's Tier equip limit to two); tabard
quests.notes: A splinter of the Cenarion Circle. Barkskin Burrow (furbolg) is a second Hyjal reputation, earned with Ceremonial Mastic; its rewards are datamined only.

quests.name: Riverglades - Alliance frontier (Brotherhood of the Horse)
quests.startsAt: Knight Commander Demar Brant, Farholde Keep (Riverglades)
steps: Support the Brotherhood of the Horse on Stormwind's lost frontier
Fight back the Horde and Twilight's Hammer in places like Sunnyglade
Story hooks include a horse rescue, a pirate operation and Jom-Jom
quests.reward: Quest XP and gear; possible Brotherhood of the Horse reputation
quests.notes: Riverglades has 150+ (some say nearly 200) new quests and lies between Redridge, Swamp of Sorrows and the Badlands. Individual quest names were not published by the sources found.

quests.name: Riverglades - Horde frontier (Boulderock ogres)
steps: Tie-in to the Krol'dok Stronghold dungeon (40-45)
quests.notes: Powderfuse Port is a neutral goblin port with a boat to Tanaris. The Bloodmasters Ring is an outdoor ogre arena.

quests.name: Shen'dralas - Gelkis and Magram centaur story
quests.startsAt: Valley of Bones (between Desolace and Mulgore)
steps: Valley of Bones, Facing the Truth, Ravaging Ravagers
Bone Raising, Outcast Necromancers, Outing Outcasts
Bone Burying, Corrupting Tears, Mountain of Bones, No Mercy for the Weak, Saving Our Own
Bristleback Retreat (kill quilboar for Hagiak at Magram Front), Long-Term Solutions, Threat of Starvation, Going Home, Return to Orgrul
quests.reward: Proof of Concept: choice of Blade of the Magram Clan, Staff of Revelations or Desperate Barrier; Gelkis or Magram reputation
quests.notes: 19 quests listed. Gelkis and Magram reputations are mutually exclusive: raising one lowers the other. The zone is also linked to the Shen'dralar, Eldre'Thalas and Dire Maul. The steps listed are quest names in level order, not a confirmed sequence.

quests.name: Old Ironforge Incursion / Hall of Thanes chain
quests.startsAt: Dun Morogh (optional start: A Visitor to Dun Morogh)
steps: Farsen's Watch, Nip 'Em in the Bud, Underground Map
Old Ironforge Incursion: claim the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer in Hall of Thanes
The Treaty of Understanding: deliver the treaty found in a vault to King Magni
Dungeon follow-ups: Important Heirlooms, The Restless Dead, An Ancient Grudge
quests.reward: 2,550 XP, +100 Ironforge and Gnomeregan Exiles reputation (Treaty)
quests.notes: Hall of Thanes is a new dungeon beneath Ironforge.

quests.name: Unending Torment (Ruins of Lordaeron)
quests.startsAt: Abominable Head looted from The Baron; ends with Master Apothecary Faranell (Undercity)
steps: Reattach the head to Othmar Garithos's body
Gather Blisterweed, Toxic Skullcap and Essence of Agony in the Undercity
Pour Hissing Serum on the body
quests.notes: Part of the Forsaken reclaiming the Ruins of Lordaeron (new dungeon). Other Ruins quests: Light's Justice, The New Plague, The Wrath of Rath'mael, Crest of Lordaeron.

quests.name: The Heartweaver story (A Frightened Request / Remember That I Love You)
quests.startsAt: Horde: Tabetha Heartweaver, The Sepulcher (Silverpine). Alliance: Crumpled Paper beside Edward's body in Ruins of Lordaeron
steps: Horde: find Edward Heartweaver's body in the Ruins of Lordaeron
Alliance: deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale, then to Avette Fellwood in Darkshire
quests.notes: Reveals that the couple's son Jeremy was adopted by Avette Fellwood.

quests.name: Dragonmaw Rumors / Open the Maw (Excavation Site: Wetlands)
steps: Open the Maw: kill Dragonmaw Saboteurs and Wardens in the Excavation Site and take the Dragonmaw Dispatch
quests.reward: Bloody Map plus Knife-Polishing Rag or Dirt-Heavy Bracers

quests.name: Kyle's Gone Missing
quests.notes: A Burning Crusade-era Make-A-Wish quest brought into Forever after fan feedback.

quests.name: Bandarion Keep (Undead Paladin class story)
quests.startsAt: Danitha Morr, Bandarion Keep, Whispering Wood (Tirisfal Glades)
steps: Murlocs at the Gates, Touring the Grounds
Making Repairs and The Tarnished (kill Tarnished Drudges and Zealots, take Commander Rudolph Gelhardt's head)
Bandarion Keep: meet Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, then A Righteous Cause
quests.reward: XP, Undercity and Argent Dawn reputation
quests.notes: Bandarion Keep (called Tyr's Watch in beta) is the Forsaken paladin hub. The story is about paladins being accepted by the wider Forsaken.

quests.name: A Lesson in Divinity (Undead Paladin Redemption)
steps: Seven-part chain, starting with a visit to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity Trade Quarter
Final part: return to Danitha Morr (from Deathguard Billmuth)
quests.notes: Follows A Token of Good Faith.

quests.name: Wolfsbane (Undead Paladin weapon)
steps: Speak with Trevan Rol in The Sepulcher (A Curious Pair, A Grim Fate)
Into Fenris Keep: free Lumina Windsinger; The Windshaper's Wrath escorts her out
Gather Whitestone Oak Lumber (Deadmines), Enchanted Silver Ingot (Shadowfang Keep) and Purified Kor Gem (Ashenvale)
A Moon-Kissed Blade / The Moonsilver Blade: Ott in Tarren Mill forges it
Kill Old Fire-Eye at the Greymane Wall and return to Lumina
quests.reward: Wolfsbane (level 31 two-handed sword); Earthen Ring reputation along the way

quests.name: Verigan's Fist (Alliance Paladin weapon)
steps: Meet Duthorian Rall in the Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
Defend Daphne Stilwell's house in Westfall from Defias waves
Bring Jordan Stilwell (Dun Morogh) the Whitestone Oak Lumber, Refined Ore Shipment, Smithing Hammer and a Purified Kor Gem
quests.notes: Classic chain, with a Kor Gem step shared with the Forsaken version.

quests.name: Summon Charger (Alliance Paladin epic mount)
quests.startsAt: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, Cathedral of Light (Stormwind)
steps: Ironforge errand, Terrordale exorcism, Arcanite Barding crafted with Grimand Elmore
Dire Maul West: defeat Tendris Warpwood and bless the barding
Scholomance Great Ossuary: summon and defeat Death Knight Darkreaver
quests.notes: Documented from quest records before launch and not yet verified on live servers. Classic costs (about 350g plus Runecloth, Arcanite and more) are not confirmed for Forever. The level 40 Warhorse is a separate quest.

quests.name: Summon Forsaken Charger (Undead Paladin epic mount)
quests.notes: Blizzard confirms a unique extended chain. Forsaken follow a Retribution path, where Alliance follows Redemption. A quest called Justice and Retribution appears in pre-launch data, but the start and steps are unverified. Undead paladins also get a Forsaken Warhorse at level 40.

quests.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth (Warlock epic mount)
quests.startsAt: Demon trainer, then Mor'zul Bloodbringer at the Altar of Storms (Burning Steppes)
steps: Rage of Blood: 30 Raging Beast's Blood in Winterspring; Wildeyes: deliver to Gorzeeki Wildeyes
Lord Banehollow (Felwood): Ulathek the Traitor, Xorothian Stardust
Reagent turn-ins: Bell of Dethmoora, Wheel of the Black March, Doomsday Candle
Imp Delivery to the Scholomance alchemy lab; Arcanite
Dreadsteed of Xoroth: five-player ritual in Dire Maul West
quests.notes: Checked against Forever 1.60.1 quest data before launch. Reagent counts may differ.

quests.name: Felsteed (Warlock mount)
quests.startsAt: Capital Warlock trainer, then Strahad Farsan (Ratchet)
steps: Starter quest from your capital trainer
quests.notes: Whether Riding must still be bought is unconfirmed. Levels 40+ were not playable in beta.

quests.name: Warlock demon quests (Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus/Incubus, Felhunter)
steps: Voidwalker (10): Gakin the Darkbinder (Stormwind), Carendin Halgar (Undercity) or Gan'rul Bloodeye (Orgrimmar)
Succubus or Incubus (20): Takar the Seer (Alliance) or Godrick Farsan / Cazul (Horde)
Felhunter (30): assemble the Tome of the Cabal for Strahad Farsan (Ratchet)
quests.reward: Demon summons, Small Soul Pouch, Box of Souls
quests.notes: The Incubus choice is new compared with Classic. Troll warlocks may not be offered the Horde Felhunter quest. Also: Staff or Orb of Soran'ruk (Doan Karhan, Barrens, 20-25).

quests.name: Warlock Infernal and Doomguard
quests.startsAt: Niby the Almighty (Felwood); Daio the Decrepit (Blasted Lands)
steps: Infernal: three Flawless Fel Essences, then kill Kroshius
Doomguard: Satyr Blood (Dire Maul), Tears of the Hederine, then capture a Doomguard Commander
quests.notes: Not verified in beta (which capped at 30).

quests.name: Dwarf Shaman totem quests
steps: Call of Earth (4): Iceclaw Bear Pendants, Earth Sapta at the Earth Spirit Stone
Call of Fire (10): Bruegs Kindleborn, then Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan
Call of Water (20): Norric Lochthane, then waterskins from Wetlands, Redridge and Ashenvale; corrupted water spirit in Westfall
Call of Air (30): Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands
quests.reward: Earth, Fire, Water and Air Totems; Stoneskin, Searing and Healing Stream Totem
quests.notes: New Alliance versions of the shaman totem quests for the new Dwarf Shaman.

quests.name: The Tempest's Weapons (Shaman weapon quest)
quests.startsAt: Alliance: Eldrun Stormbreaker (Ironforge). Horde: Prate Cloudseer (Thousand Needles)
steps: Elemental Aid: kill Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul
Storm, Earth, and Fire: 5 each of Water, Air, Earth and Fire Twisted Totems
Heed My Call: place Corrupted Totems at the Thousand Needles steam pools and defeat the Ravaging Tempest
Hand the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher (Alterac Mountains)
quests.reward: Choice of Rage of the Storm, Lightning's Grasp or Tidebringer's Claw; Alliance also get Elementalist's Guard
quests.notes: Numbers come from beta.

quests.name: Embracing the Elements (Skyborne Shaman)
steps: Call of Earth (Zephras Isle), parts 1 and 2
quests.reward: Earth Totem (and the Fire Totem later on the isle)

quests.name: Whirlwind Weapon (Warrior: Berserker Stance and Cyclonian)
quests.startsAt: Warrior trainer in your capital (The Islander)
steps: Travel to Klannoc Macleod on Fray Island (Barrens)
The Affray: arena event ending with Big Will, which teaches Berserker Stance
The Windwatcher: find Bath'rah in Alterac Mountains
Cyclonian: 8 Liferoot, 30 Bloodscalp Tusks and an Essence of the Exile
The Summoning: kill Cyclonian (level 40 elite) for the Whirlwind Heart
quests.reward: Choice of Whirlwind Axe, Sword or Warhammer (item level 40)
quests.notes: Starts at 30 in Forever. The sword and warhammer options are new.

quests.name: Druid Bear Form
quests.startsAt: Night Elf: Mathrengyl Bearwalker (Darnassus). Tauren: Turak Runetotem (Thunder Bluff). Skyborne: Lotheluum Starbreeze
steps: Heeding the Call and the Moonglade spirit step (Skyborne: The Great Ursera Spirit, Urs'endris near Valanaar)
Body and Heart: summon and defeat Lunaclaw (Skyborne: Strength and Mercy in the Shen'dar Highlands)
quests.notes: The Skyborne version is new.

quests.name: Druid Aquatic Form
quests.startsAt: Druid trainer (A Lesson to Learn), then Dendrite Starblaze (Moonglade)
steps: Trial of the Sea Lion: combine the two pendant halves
quests.reward: Aquatic Form; choice of Aquarius Belt or Idol of Shifting Tides

quests.name: Druid Cat Form (The Great Cat Spirit)
quests.startsAt: Mathrengyl Bearwalker or Turak Runetotem; Skyborne via the Avatar of Saeyleenan
steps: The Great Cat Spirit (Skyborne: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit)
Collect three relics from the Stormrage Barrow Dens
To Darnassus or To Thunder Bluff to learn the form
quests.notes: Cat Form is a quest in Forever; in Classic it was bought from the trainer.

quests.name: Taming the Beast (Hunter pet quest)
quests.startsAt: Hunter trainer in each starting zone (Teldrassil, Dun Morogh, Zephras Isle, Mulgore, Durotar)
steps: Tame three set beasts with the Taming Rod
quests.notes: There is a new Zephras Isle version (quest 94978). Human hunters are new in Forever; their version was not detailed.

quests.name: Rhok'delar (Stave of the Ancients)
quests.startsAt: Ancient Petrified Leaf (Molten Core), then Vartrus the Ancient (Felwood)
steps: Hunt the four demonic corrupters solo: Simone, Klinfran, Solenor and Artorius
Combine the stave with a bowstring from Stoma
quests.reward: Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers (or Lok'delar)
quests.notes: The wiki says the quest remains in Forever. It needs the Ancient Petrified Leaf from Molten Core, whose presence in Forever is not confirmed.

quests.name: Benediction / Anathema (The Balance of Light and Shadow)
steps: Get The Eye of Divinity (Molten Core, Majordomo's cache) and The Eye of Shadow (demons in Winterspring and Blasted Lands)
Save 50 peasants fleeing Stratholme before 15 die
Combine the Splinter of Nordrassil with both Eyes
quests.notes: The wiki says the quest remains in Forever. It needs a Molten Core drop; Molten Core is not confirmed for Forever.

quests.name: Skyborne class starter quests
steps: Hunter: The Way of the Hunter
Mage (Alliance): A Student of the Arcane
Rogue: At Home in the Shadows
quests.reward: Early class items (e.g. a druid idol or shaman totem)

quests.name: Northfold Manor
steps: Kill 10 Syndicate Highwaymen and 6 Syndicate Mercenaries
quests.notes: Quest ID 681. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Call to Arms
steps: Slay 10 Witherbark Axe Throwers, 10 Headhunters, 8 Witch Doctors
Kill 10 Boulderfist Brutes and 4 Boulderfist Magi
Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords
quests.notes: Quest ID 677. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Foul Magics
steps: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Bloodstone Orb; bring it to Tor'gan
quests.reward: White Drakeskin Cap / Radiant Silver Bracers
quests.notes: Quest ID 671. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: The Giant in the Den
steps: Bring them to Drum Fel in Hammerfall
quests.notes: Item-started warning to Drum Fel about the goliath he faces. Quest ID 92707.

quests.name: Hammerfall
quests.notes: Quest ID 655. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Raising Spirits
steps: Acquire 10 Highland Raptor Eyes from Highland Striders and Thrashers
Give the Raptor Talon Amulet to Gor'mul
quests.notes: Quest ID 672. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Crystal in the Mountains
steps: Find the crystal from your vision; hand in Shards of Myzrael
quests.notes: Quest ID 635. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Land Ho!
steps: Speak with Captain O'Breen in Faldir's Cove
quests.notes: Quest ID 663. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Legends of the Earth
quests.notes: Changed in Forever; listed with an <NYI> tag in the Forever data. Quest ID 636.

quests.name: Silky Sutures
quests.notes: Silk for field sutures in Hammerfall's infirmary; leads to Ward Restocking. Quest ID 97539.

quests.name: Ward Restocking
steps: Pick up the Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm
Return them to Doctor Gregory Victor
quests.notes: Follow-up to Silky Sutures; Jorell never delivered the infirmary's supplies. Quest ID 92519.

quests.name: Worth Its Weight in Gold
steps: Gather 10 Witherbark Tusks, 4 Medicine Pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife for Kryten
quests.notes: Quest ID 691. Classic quest still present in Forever.

quests.name: Guile of the Raptor
steps: Acquire 12 Raptor Hearts from Highland Fleshstalkers

quests.notes: Check in with Yorana Windyreed at the eastern watchtower in the Gustberry Lowlands.

quests.name: Disrupting Logistics
quests.notes: Kill 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.

quests.name: Breaking the Breaker
quests.reward: Choice: Hunter's Cord, Windsong Bangles or Breaker's Gauntlets
quests.notes: Kill Commander Belguilos in the Gustberry Lowlands.

quests.name: Return to Valanaar
quests.reward: Choice: Honed Greathammer, Quickblade's Dagger or Balanced Quarterstaff
quests.notes: Take Yorana's report to Valennia Stormfist.

quests.name: Prepare for Battle
quests.notes: Meet Valennia at the forward position in the Gustberry Lowlands (61.2, 70.9).

quests.name: Making Our Move
quests.notes: Kill 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Spiritcallers and 7 Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze.

quests.name: The Inner Sanctum
quests.notes: Join Valennia inside the inner sanctum of the Shrine of Akir.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.reward: Choice: Belt of Blades, Empyrean Shoes, Empyrean Greatsword or Empyrean Treads
quests.notes: Go through the portal to the Rohashi Spires and help confront High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.notes: Alliance version of the Rohashi Spires finale against High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.notes: Epilogue: speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.notes: Alliance epilogue to the Zephras Isle story.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.notes: Speak with Elaadrin Evengale when ready to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.notes: Horde send-off quest before leaving Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Magical City of Dalaran
quests.notes: Ride the skycutter from Zephras Isle to Dalaran and find Denaaris Stargale in the Sky Enclave.

quests.name: The Earthen Ring
quests.notes: Take the skycutter to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker.

quests.name: Unnerving Silence
quests.notes: Find Elegael Thornpaw in northeastern Shadowgale Forest (61.6, 39.2).

quests.name: A Sacrifice in Vain
quests.notes: Speak with Elegael in northeastern Shadowgale Forest.

quests.name: Feathers for Binding
quests.notes: Collect 20 Pristine Shriekling Feathers from Shadowgale Shrieklings.

quests.name: Unwanted and Unworthy
quests.notes: Recover 10 Bloody Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Stormchasers.

quests.name: The Ties That Bind
quests.notes: Kill Commander Haalien and bring back his head.

quests.name: Ripped Missive
quests.notes: Bring the missive to Elegael Thornpaw.

quests.name: Tears of the Lady
quests.notes: Gather 8 Lady's Tear Moss.

quests.name: The Wounds of Betrayal
quests.notes: Enter the Nightfang Den, heal 7 injured druids, find Jorel Windsinger and defeat the named foes inside.

quests.name: The Fate of the Den
quests.notes: Deliver the missive to Lotheluum in Valanaar and explain events.

quests.name: Unwelcome Visitors
quests.notes: Collect 8 Shriekling Talons in Shadowgale Forest.

quests.name: The Strange Hermit
quests.notes: Meet the gnome hermit who teaches Engineering.

quests.name: The Forest's Bounty
quests.notes: Gathering task for the Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest.

quests.name: Free the Hollows
quests.notes: Hermit task to free the Wind Hollows in Shadowgale Forest.

quests.name: Taming the Beast
quests.notes: Hunter pet chain: tame a Vuldren Alpha in the Gustberry Lowlands with the Taming Rod and return it.

quests.name: Training the Beast
quests.notes: Hunter pet chain finale: speak with Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.

quests.name: Speak with Belann
quests.notes: Speak with Belann Windwood in Valanaar (class/type not stated by source).

quests.name: Boughs in the Wind
quests.notes: Bring a Wind-Infused Bough to Belann in Valanaar (class/type not stated by source).

quests.name: Valley of Bones
quests.notes: Gelkis path: raise Gelkis standing and find Nerlokh east of Gelkis Village near the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Ravaging Ravagers
quests.startsAt: Nerlokh, Valley of Bones south entrance
quests.notes: Gelkis path: kill 6 Undead Ravagers.

quests.name: Facing the Truth
quests.notes: Gelkis path: bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.

quests.name: A Cleansing Cry
quests.notes: Gelkis path: get 3 Tears of Theradras from Mulara and bring them to Uthek the Wise.

quests.name: Test Your Theory
quests.reward: Choice: Centaur Spear, Wanderer's Broadsword or Desert Crawler's Claw
quests.notes: Gelkis path: dispel the curse on the Accursed Skull at the pond ritual site east of Gelkis Village with Uthek's Draenethyst Staff; turn in to Nerlokh.

quests.name: Outing Outcasts
quests.notes: Gelkis path: bring a Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh.

quests.name: Saving Our Own
quests.notes: Gelkis path: free 5 Gelkis Captives in the Valley of Bones; turn in to Nerlokh.

quests.name: Bone Burying
quests.notes: Gelkis path: lift the curses from 8 failed summons in the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Checking Things Out
quests.notes: Gelkis path: scout centaur points of interest and report to Nerlokh.

quests.name: Going Home
quests.notes: Gelkis path: escort Rokren out of the Outcast Hideaway, then tell Nerlokh.

quests.name: A Conqueror's Crown
quests.notes: Magram path: fetch a Conqueror's Crown from a Badlands crypt for Warug in Magram Village.

quests.name: Outcast Necromancers
quests.notes: Magram path: kill 6 Outcast Necromancers in the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Mountain of Bones
quests.notes: Magram path: deliver 426 Gently Cursed Bones to Orgrul.

quests.name: Corrupting Tears
quests.notes: Magram path: bring 3 Petrified Bark and 3 Imbued Tears to Orgrul.

quests.name: Proof of Concept
quests.reward: Choice: Blade of the Magram Clan, Staff of Revelations or Desperate Barrier; +500 Magram rep
quests.notes: Magram path: prove you can wield the Necrokhan's staff by bringing 426 Well Cursed Bones.

quests.name: Bone Raising
quests.notes: Magram path: use the Enhanced Necromancy Staff to raise or kill 10 Haggard Bones in the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: No Mercy for the Weak
quests.notes: Magram path: kill 5 Gelkis Captives in the Valley of Bones (the opposite choice to Saving Our Own).

quests.name: Bristleback Retreat
quests.notes: Magram path: kill 4 Bristleback Nomads, 6 Thornweavers and 6 Skullcrushers; report to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

quests.name: Long-Term Solutions
quests.notes: Magram path: kill 2 Outcast Scouts, 6 Marauders and 8 Necromancers for Hagiak.

quests.name: Threat of Starvation
quests.notes: Magram path: bring 6 Stolen Supplies to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

quests.name: Return to Orgrul
quests.notes: Magram path: report back to Orgrul at the north end of the Valley of Bones.

quests.name: Khan Jehn
quests.reward: Choice: Greatstaff of the Necrokhans, Soulsplatter Mace or Scavenged Magram Armament; +6000 Magram rep
quests.notes: Magram finale: perform the necromantic ritual at Magram Village's central lake to raise Khan Jehn.

quests.name: Remember That I Love You
quests.notes: Take the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale in Stormwind.

quests.name: Remember That I Love You (2)
quests.notes: Deliver the letter onward to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.

quests.name: To Have Loved and Lost
quests.notes: Questline that rebuilds a phased druid camp (well, tools and repairs improve as you progress).

quests.name: Friendly Advice
quests.notes: Required alongside Friendly with the Guardians of Hyjal to buy some high-level profession patterns.

quests.name: Prison Break In
quests.notes: Horde Dalaran key chain: gather the four Bloodstone pieces from the Lordamere Internment Camp.

quests.name: Key to the City
quests.notes: Grab the Grimy Key (Dalaran Sewer Key) from the footlocker in Kegan Darkmar's house and return with the Bloodstones.

quests.name: Dalaran Patrols
quests.notes: Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 8 Elemental Slaves at the Dalaran ruins (26.0, 61.8).

quests.name: Blood in the Streets
quests.notes: Find the Image of Archmage Modera by the Dalaran sewer entrance and speak with her.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.startsAt: Image of Archmage Modera, outside Dalaran
quests.notes: Take an Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage in the Violet Chamber and bring it to Magus Wordeen Voidglare.

quests.name: Shrewd Negotiations
quests.notes: Hand the Arcane Mote to Archmage Modera outside Dalaran.

quests.name: Stone Tokens
quests.notes: Optional: collect 10 Worn Stone Tokens from Lordamere Internment Camp guards.

quests.name: Bracers of Binding
quests.notes: Optional follow-up: collect 4 Bracers of Earth Binding from Elemental Slaves.

quests.name: An Alarming Request
quests.notes: Report to the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran; opens the Alliance dungeon quests.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.startsAt: Image of Archmage Modera, outside Dalaran
quests.reward: Choice incl. Spellguard Pauldrons, Renewing Footpads, Defender of Dalaran
quests.notes: Take an Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage and return it to Modera.

quests.name: Friend of the Kirin Tor
quests.startsAt: Image of Archmage Modera, outside Dalaran
quests.notes: Bring the Arcane Mote to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel (14.2, 60.1).

quests.name: Strahnbrad Mystery
quests.notes: Solve what happened at Strahnbrad and report back in Hillsbrad.

quests.name: A Donation of Silk
quests.notes: Donate 60 Silk Cloth (High Order cloth donation).

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.notes: Offered to Skyborne arrivals in Dalaran's Sky Enclave next to the Stormwind portal; details not yet published.

quests.notes: Classic: thin out Syndicate assassins in Alterac.

quests.name: Encrypted Letter

quests.name: Foreboding Plans
quests.notes: Classic: bring the Syndicate plans to Magistrate Maleb.

quests.name: Further Mysteries
quests.notes: Classic: carry Stormpike's findings to Magistrate Maleb.

quests.name: Letter to Stormpike
quests.notes: Classic: deliver a letter to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: Valik
quests.notes: Classic: errand for Henchman Valik in Alterac.

quests.name: Crushridge Bounty
quests.notes: Classic: hunt Crushridge ogres.

quests.name: Noble Deaths
quests.notes: Classic: collect signet rings from Syndicate nobles.

quests.name: Assassin's Contract
quests.notes: Classic: turn the assassin's contract in to Magistrate Maleb.

quests.name: Baron's Demise
quests.notes: Classic: kill Baron Vardus.

quests.name: Crushridge Warmongers
quests.notes: Classic elite ogre quest, changed in Forever.

quests.name: Dark Council
quests.notes: Classic: break up the Dark Council at Alterac.

quests.name: Stormpike's Deciphering
quests.notes: Classic: bring the deciphered text to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: The Ensorcelled Parchment
quests.notes: Classic: take the parchment to Loremaster Dibbs.

zones.name: Zephras Isle
zones.changed: New floating sky-island starting zone for the Skyborne race; Skyborne of either faction start here and leave by airship from Valanaar around level 12.
highlights: Valanaar and Valanaar Skydocks (airship links to Alliance and Horde)
Thendal Village (where the zone storyline begins)
Shen'dar Village, Falaath Village, Shrine of Akir

zones.name: Riverglades
zones.changed: New frontier zone in south-eastern Khaz Modan (east of Badlands/Burning Steppes, bordering Redridge and Swamp of Sorrows) with 150+ quests and a neutral goblin port.
highlights: Powderfuse Port (neutral goblin port, boat to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris)
Sunnyglade, Windstead, Meadowsbrook, Wheeler's Grange, Twilight's Shroud, Terral's Watch

zones.name: Shen'dralas
zones.changed: New zone in central Kalimdor between Desolace, Feralas and Mulgore, reached from Desolace through the Valley of Bones; story follows the Shen'dralar Highborne exiles and the Magram/Gelkis centaur conflict. Level range varies by source (Warcraft Tavern gives minimum recommended 40; mein-mmo 45-55; wiki lists it as unknown).
highlights: Quests tie into Dire Maul, Razorfen Downs and Maraudon

zones.name: Mount Hyjal
zones.changed: New level-60 endgame zone set after Archimonde's defeat, with the forests recovering; reached on foot from Winterspring via Darkwhisper Gorge. Houses multiple questlines, reputations and the two new raids.
highlights: Cradle of Tranquility, Dae'gun, Elderwild, Malorne's Retreat, Mourning's Rest
Shrine of Aviana, Summit of Eternity, Tainted Foothills

zones.name: Elwynn Forest
zones.changed: Starting zones in Forever were upgraded with campsites, expanded local quests and early profession hooks (per Gfinity).

zones.name: Dun Morogh
zones.changed: Starting zone upgraded with campsites and expanded local quests; Gnomeregan entrance here.

zones.name: Tirisfal Glades
zones.changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map; the new Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon sits in the ruined city above the Undercity, entered near the Brill-side approach.

zones.name: Mulgore
zones.changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map (borders the new Shen'dralas zone).

zones.name: Westfall
highlights: Start of the Cozy Sleeping Bag quest chain (level 14+)

zones.name: Darkshore
zones.changed: Auberdine is a stop on the Menethil Harbor - Southshore - Auberdine ferry loop and also linked to Stormwind Harbor.

zones.name: The Barrens
zones.changed: Hosts a Darkspear Islands battlemaster; Northwatch has the Alliance Theramore Expeditionary Force base with a portal to the battleground, and the Barrens is a Cozy Sleeping Bag chain start.
highlights: Wailing Caverns, Razorfen Kraul, Razorfen Downs

zones.name: Redridge Mountains
zones.changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map; borders the new Riverglades.

zones.name: Wetlands
zones.changed: Expanded with 25+ new quests, a reworked leveling flow and the new Excavation Site: Wetlands dungeon at Whelgar's Excavation; Menethil Harbor runs a ferry loop to Southshore and Auberdine.

zones.name: Hillsbrad Foothills
zones.changed: Southshore is a ferry stop; Southshore (Alliance) and Tarren Mill (Horde) start the City of Dalaran attunement quests.
highlights: Emissary Jacques in Southshore ("An Alarming Request")
Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill ("Key to the City")

zones.name: Alterac Mountains
zones.changed: Substantively changed map: Dalaran's barrier has fallen and the restored city is a playable area with its own quests and the City of Dalaran dungeon.

zones.name: Desolace
zones.changed: Flagged as substantively changed on the Forever map; gains campsites and expanded quests and connects to Shen'dralas through the Valley of Bones.

zones.name: Stranglethorn Vale
zones.changed: New underwater-entrance dungeon The Drowned City off the coast west of Grom'gol; Booty Bay's Pix Xizzix trades for Tarnished Undermine Reals.

zones.name: Badlands
zones.changed: Borders the new Riverglades.

zones.name: Dustwallow Marsh
zones.changed: Alcaz Island now holds the Alcaz Prison dungeon; the Darkspear Islands battleground lies off its coast; Onyxia's Lair returns as a 40-player raid.

zones.name: Swamp of Sorrows
zones.changed: Borders the new Riverglades.

zones.name: Tanaris
zones.changed: New boat route from Steamwheedle Port to Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

zones.name: Azshara
zones.changed: A long-sealed furbolg gate in northern Azshara now leads to the Blackmaw Hold dungeon (portal sits on the Winterspring side).

zones.name: Un'Goro Crater
zones.changed: New titan dungeon Shaper's Terrace on the northern hills above Marshal's Refuge, powered by crystals gathered around the crater.

zones.name: Eastern Plaguelands
zones.changed: Flagged by the wiki as substantively changed on the Forever map (details not given).

zones.name: Winterspring
zones.changed: Connects west to Mount Hyjal through Darkwhisper Gorge and has one of the Barrow Deeps raid entrances; Blackmaw Hold's portal is on its map.

zones.name: Stormwind City
zones.changed: Flagged as substantively changed on the Forever map; Stormwind Harbor sails to Auberdine.

zones.name: Ironforge
zones.changed: New Hall of Thanes dungeon beneath the city, entered at the High Seat.

zones.name: Undercity
highlights: Ruins of Lordaeron dungeon above the city

instances.name: The Hall of Thanes
instances.location: Ironforge (entrance at the High Seat), Dun Morogh
instances.notes: Dwarven royal burial halls broken into by suspected Dark Iron dwarves. Easy access for Alliance; Horde must travel into Ironforge.
strategy: Faldrim Anvilmar: clear the ghosts around the tomb first; dispel Anvilmar's Curse from the tank (-20% attack and cast speed); interrupting Mind Blast is optional
Magmatus: kill the Dark Iron Summoner first; ranged stay back from his fire pulses, and healers watch all melee
Plunder: tank him with your back to a wall so his knockback is safe; pull him away from other mobs
Durgen Dirgehammer: clear the room first because his AoE fear scatters the group; kill his two Lesser Stone Golems first; Tremor Totem helps
tips: The city sits on lava: falling in is lethal
Shoot the Seaforium Blasting Powder kegs from range before engaging nearby packs
Bloodhound Runts' Infected Wounds raise physical damage taken: cure disease, Simple Poultice or Stoneform
Horde can run it, but entry is awkward and there are no Horde quests

instances.name: Ragefire Chasm
instances.notes: Classic dungeon; level range retuned for Forever.
strategy: Oggleflint: mark and kill his two adds first
Taragaman the Hungerer: watch positioning: his Uppercut can knock people into the lava
Jergosh the Invoker: clear his two adds, interrupt Immolate, watch mana
Bazzalan: hits hard; cleanse Deadly Poison and kill his two adds first
tips: Packs are tight: pull carefully, use line of sight and crowd control
Only Horde can do its 5 quests; Alliance get the Hall of Thanes instead

instances.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
instances.location: Ruins above the Undercity, Tirisfal Glades
instances.notes: Scourge-haunted ruins with a necromancer (Rath'mael) as end boss. Easy Horde access; Alliance must cross Horde territory.
strategy: Witherfang: doesn't social-aggro, so pull her alone from range; kill Broodlings first
The Baron: tank against a wall (stun knockback); ranged spread out; be ready to kite if he switches target
Viktor the Vile: top up mana before lighting the fireplace: five waves of adds come first; then tank and spank
The Abandoned: interrupt Drain Life on the tank; fight through Frost Nova after three add waves; start full mana
Bjork: tank and spank; switch to physical damage while his Anti-Magic Shield is up
Rath'mael: interrupt or move melee away from the Flamestrike aimed at the tank, then reposition
Lordaeron Captain (rare, west side): tank and spank; Horde only
tips: Cure Ghoul Plague immediately (30-min slow and damage loss)
Dispel Frost Armor on Skeletal Mages
Use magic on Stone Watchers during Stone Slumber
Alliance: run out rather than hearth, to hand the Head of the Baron to Captain Truman

instances.name: The Deadmines
instances.notes: Classic dungeon.
strategy: Rhahk'zor: kill the Watchmen first
Miner Johnson (rare): tank and spank
Sneed's Shredder: clear the Woodcarvers; after the Shredder dies, taunt Sneed (he disarms: use non-weapon abilities)
Gilnid: clear his room first: Molten Metal lowers tank threat
Mr. Smite: kill the Blackguards; save cooldowns for phase two when he dual-wields
Captain Greenskin: kill his two adds first; easy to pull by accident
Edwin VanCleef: kill the first adds, control the second set, burn him below half health
Cookie: interrupt Cookie's Cooking (heals him)
tips: Unchanged from Classic apart from loot; one new quest in a new Westfall chain
All six quests are Alliance-only

instances.name: Wailing Caverns
instances.notes: Classic dungeon.
strategy: Kresh: tank facing away, cooldowns for big hits; casters do best (high armour)
Lady Anacondra: interrupt Lightning Bolt, Sleep and Healing Touch
Lord Cobran: kill his three Deviate Pythons first; HoT the tank in case healers get slept
Deviate Faerie Dragon: burn without pulling aggro
Lord Pythas: hold the Druid of the Fang add too; interrupt casts
Skum: face him away, spread for Chained Bolt and interrupt it (Nature immune)
Lord Serpentis: interrupt Healing Touch, Sleep and Lightning Bolt
Verdan the Everliving: healers stand far back; ranged 10+ yards from Grasping Vines
Mutanus the Devourer: kill oozes and snakes first, tank him away from Naralex's disciple, interrupt Naralex's Nightmare
tips: New loot includes a set that turns Druid Cat Form into a serpent
Elites patrol the outer cavern: travel as a group

instances.name: Shadowfang Keep
instances.notes: Classic dungeon.
strategy: Rethilgore: kill his adds first; healers cover Wavering Will (must die to open the courtyard)
Razorclaw the Butcher: clear and mark the adds first
Baron Silverlaine: clear his room; interrupt or decurse Veil of Shadow (-75% healing)
Commander Springvale: pull small groups; interrupt Holy Light after his Divine Shield at 30%
Odo the Blindwatcher: kill the Vile Bats; save cooldowns for under 50% (Howling Rage)
Deathsworn Captain: face him away (Cleave), DPS behind
Fenrus the Devourer: tank and spank with defensives
Wolf Master Nandos: wolves join at 80%: cleave them carefully
Archmage Arugal: crowd-control mind-controlled players; his curse can't be dispelled
tips: Mostly unchanged apart from loot
Skyborne can reach it easily from Dalaran

instances.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
instances.notes: Time-frozen titan area guarded by stray constructs and wildlife; Explorers' League interest. Final boss is level 31, so wiki suggests 26-32 in practice.
strategy: Saltspine: clear a dry arena first; ranged and healers stay out of the sandstorm (accuracy debuff)
Shadetooth: clear the reed raptors (they call for help); dispel the AoE fear fast; save defensives for the low-health enrage
Highland Horror: pull it away from the slimes; leave its root area at once; interrupt its self-heal
Relic Guardian: activate at the Archival Panel beside the column on the right; don't tank near the edge (knockback)
tips: Bring disease cures: Infected Wounds, Muculent Rot and Highland Venom
Horde need Dragonmaw Rumors (Zaruk, Arathi Highlands) before Open the Maw
Tremor Totem helps against Shadetooth
Raptor bleeds can kill squishies fast

instances.name: The Stockade
instances.notes: Classic dungeon; level range raised for Forever.
strategy: Targorr the Dread: kill adds first
Kam Deepfury: hold aggro through Shield Slam stuns; kill adds first
Hamhock: kill his two Defias adds; interrupt Chain Lightning, purge Bloodlust
Bazil Thredd: clear the room before pulling
Bruegal Ironknuckle (rare): tank and spank
Dextren Ward: kill adds first; be ready for Intimidating Shout
tips: Mostly unchanged apart from loot
The T-shaped cell block wings can be done in any order

instances.name: City of Dalaran
instances.location: Dalaran, Alterac Mountains (sewer grate on the west wall)
instances.notes: Needs a Dalaran Sewer Key via attunement: Alliance 'An Alarming Request' (Emissary Jacques, Southshore); Horde 'Key to the City'/'Prison Break-In' (Magus Wordeen Voidglare, Tarren Mill).
strategy: Atrexis the Grave Knight: clear around him without pulling; tank his skeletons; heal or purge Unholy Frenzy
Lyn the Ignored (secret boss, needs a Tome of Dalaran): tank his skeletons; remove Curse of Thorns
Mana Devourer: clear Violet Hold first; a healing check against Drain Vitality and Debilitate
Arcane Anomaly: stack tightly behind it to dodge the rotating Focal Blast beam
Fel Ancient: talk to Magus Fansy Goodbringer in Runeweaver Square to drop the barrier; break roots and avoid Fel Timbers pools
Arcanic Enigma: kill both Mana Phantoms (Mana Burn) first; ranged stay away from its polymorph and AoE silence
Unstable Sentry: spread out; melee leave when it casts Malfunction
Shade of the Archmage: ranged spread and dodge Bounding Mana; break Mass Polymorph when it runs out of mana
tips: Tremor Totem stops Mindless Horrors' fear chain-pulls
Completing Heart of Disruption unlocks the open-world Dalaran and makes guards friendly to Horde
A locked door after the first bridge leads straight to the Violet Citadel, skipping most of the dungeon

instances.name: Blackfathom Deeps
instances.notes: Classic dungeon.
strategy: Ghamoo-ra: face it away; reposition after Trample
Lady Sarevess: crowd-control one add; spread out for Forked Lightning
Gelihast: pull his room's adds one at a time; ranged stay close so Net lowers threat; click the stone behind him for Blessing of Blackfathom
Lorgus Jett: tank and spank; watch melee for Lightning Shield
Baron Aquanis: tank and spank
Twilight Lord Kelris: tank away from the group; taunt if the tank is slept
Old Serra'kis: underwater: manage breath
Aku'mai: tank away from ranged, step out of Poison Cloud, save stuns and cooldowns for Frenzied Rage
tips: Unchanged apart from loot
Lorgus Jett and Baron Aquanis are for Horde quests

instances.name: Razorfen Kraul
instances.notes: Classic dungeon.
strategy: Roogug: kill the Death's Head Seer first
Aggem Thorncurse: kill the low-health boar spirits fast
Death Speaker Jargba: Acolyte, then Groundshaker, then Jargba
Overlord Ramtusk: keep the Spearhides away; melee step out before Whirling Barrage
Earthcaller Halmgar (rare): kill the Stone Rumbler and totems, interrupt Lightning Bolt
Agathelos the Raging: keep the tank alive; keep hitting through his feign death
Blind Hunter (rare): clear bats, taunt him away from casters (Sonic Burst silences)
Charlga Razorflank: spread for Chain Bolt; skip DoTs (Purity dispels them)
tips: Largely unchanged apart from loot

instances.name: Gnomeregan
instances.notes: Classic dungeon.
strategy: Grubbis: kill his pet Chomper first
Viscous Fallout: immune to Frost
Electrocutioner 6000: spread out; tank at max melee range (Chain Bolt can't be interrupted); drops the Workshop Key
Crowd Pummeler 9-60: tank against a wall away from the healer; ranged at max range
Dark Iron Ambassador (rare): kill Burning Servants as they spawn, interrupt Fireball
Mekgineer Thermaplugg: tank in the middle; retaunt after Knock Away; kill Walking Bombs or press the pillar buttons
tips: Largely unchanged apart from loot

instances.name: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard

classes.name: Warrior
classes.forevChanges: Rage from hits taken ignores armor/absorbs; rage from dealing damage scales with weapon speed and crits give 75% more. Tactical Mastery (lvl 14) and Victory Rush (lvl 20) baseline; Recklessness/Retaliation/Shield Wall no longer share a cooldown. New talents: Weaponmaster and Spearing Strike (Arms), Raging Blows and redesigned Enrage, Bloodthirst no longer heals (Fury), Vanguard lets Charge work in Defensive Stance, plus Bastion and Focused Rage (Protection). New race option: Skyborne (both factions). Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.forevChanges: Now available to the Horde via the new Undead Paladin combo. Holy Strike at level 6; Judgment no longer consumes Seals; Consecration baseline at 20 but much weaker. Holy: Holy Shock 10s cooldown, Infusion of Light, Light's Vigil, Reverence. Protection: Seal of Fury tank seal (Judgment taunts), Swift Judgment, Reckoning on blocks. Retribution: Vindication, Sacred Arbiter, Champion of the Light, Twist of Light. Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.forevChanges: New combos: Human Hunter and Skyborne Hunter. Aimed Shot baseline at 20; traps usable in combat (30s cooldown, Frost and Fire separate). New Fox pet family; pets scale from hunter gear and each family has one unique ability. New talents: Lone Wolf (petless play), Summon Hawk, Careful Aim, Rapid Killing, Strider Kick, Lacerating Strikes; Survival can go full melee. Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.forevChanges: Only new combo is Skyborne. Can use one-handed axes; poisons have more charges and stack with sharpening stones/weightstones; Sap no longer breaks stealth. New talents: Mutilate and Venom (Assassination), Hack and Slash and Flawless Execution (Combat), Thousand Cuts, Quietus, Cutthroat (Subtlety). Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Priest
classes.forevChanges: New combo: Gnome Priest. Racial priest spells reworked: Fear Ward and Devouring Plague for all priests at 20, Divine Spirit baseline at 30, Shadow Word: Death at 32. Fade threat drop doubled; Renew from multiple priests stacks on one target. New talents: Penance and Soul Warding (Discipline), Binding Heal and Prayer of Mending (Holy), Devouring Contagion, Early Demise and reworked Shadowform (Shadow). Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.forevChanges: Now available to the Alliance via the new Dwarf Shaman combo; Skyborne shamans are Horde-only. Totems last 5 min, 1.0s GCD, totem bar UI, Totemic Recall/Projection and Call of the Elements/Spirits/Ancestors totem sets. Windfury and Flametongue are party buffs; imbues last 60 min and stack with oils. New talents include Lava Burst, Lightning Overload, Stormstrike (16-pt), Rage of the Farseer, Water Shield, Mana Tide Totem, Riptide; guides note Rockbiter may enable Enhancement tanking. Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Mage
classes.forevChanges: New combos: Orc Mage and Skyborne Mage (Alliance only). New baseline Comprehension (scroll-reading tradeskill) and Frostfire Bolt at 40. New talents: Arcane Blast, Missile Barrage, Hot Streak (Fire), Ice Lance, Fingers of Frost. Cone of Cold and Improved Blizzard slow nerfed to curb AoE farming. Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.forevChanges: New combo: Troll Warlock. Curse of Agony and Curse of Doom become Banes (one per warlock per target); Curse of Shadows removed; Firestone/Spellstone become weapon imbues; pets scale with the warlock. New talents: Wrack, Malediction, Soul Siphon, Pandemic (Affliction); Demonic Brand, Demonic Knowledge, Demonic Pact (Demonology); Bane of Havoc, Incinerate, Shadow and Flame (Destruction). Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: Druid
classes.forevChanges: New combo: Skyborne Druid (both factions) with unique bird-like forms. Nature's Grasp (10), Omen of Clarity (20), Lacerate (42), Improved Mark of the Wild baseline; new Revive out-of-combat res at 12. Feral: Shifting Power (powershifting returns), Primal Bite replaces Mangle, Berserk. Restoration: Wild Growth. Wrath cheaper but weaker; shapeshifted druids can use most potions. Dual Specialization unlocks at level 40 from the class trainer (Blizzard deep dives); a 50g price is not confirmed by the sources read.

classes.name: New race/class combos
classes.forevChanges: Blizzard's six new combos for existing races: Gnome Priest, Human Hunter, Dwarf Shaman (Alliance gets Shaman), Orc Mage, Troll Warlock, Undead Paladin (Horde gets Paladin). The new Skyborne race (shen'dorei, start zone Zephras Isle, levels 1-12) is split by faction: High Order Skyborne (Alliance: Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue, Warrior) and Windshaper Skyborne (Horde: Druid, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warrior). Shared racials: Walk on Air (10s glide), Wind Blessed (+1% Haste), Elemental Insight (+5% damage vs elementals); Windshaper adds Skysight (+10% run speed), High Order adds Read Ley Line (+100% health/mana regen on a ley line).

classes.name: Dual specialization
classes.forevChanges: Dual Talent Specialization is taught by class trainers from level 40 (stated in Blizzard's class deep dives). None of the sources read confirm a price: the 50g figure matches Season of Discovery and is unverified for Forever. Normal talent resets cost 1g, then 5g, rising to a 50g cap and decaying weekly; Legacy tree resets cost 10g.

professions.name: Alchemy
professions.trainers: Profession trainers in capital cities and many towns
professions.changes: Every profession caps at 300 (Apprentice 75 / Journeyman 150 / Expert 225 / Artisan 300). No passive profession combat bonuses; Legacy perks Working Overtime (up to 5 ranks, +4% skill-up chance per the guide) and Dedicated Study (1 rank, daily: +1 skill to your lowest tradeskill, or 2-4 Elemental Essences once all are 300) apply. 66 new recipes. The six standard Healing Potions moved to First Aid; Alchemy instead gets a Discolored Healing Potion line (heals, then returns part of it as damage over time). Camp objects: Mana Well (skill 20, mana regen like Blessing of Wisdom), Fermenter (Blueprint from Rath'mael, Ruins of Lordaeron), Alchemy Laboratory (tier 3).
professions.levelingTips: Pair with Herbalism; most of the route is herbs (Stranglekelp, Peacebloom, Gromsblood). Roughly 335-390 crafts to 300.

news.title: Blizzard calls Forever WoW's biggest launch
news.summary: Blizzard says Forever set a new record for peak concurrent players and brought back more lapsed players than any previous WoW launch. No actual player numbers were shared. Queues stayed minimal even though each ruleset runs as one large regional world.

news.title: First players hit level 60 in about three days
news.summary: A five-player group made up of a Paladin, a Shaman and three Mages reached the cap together a little over three days after launch. They leveled mostly by pulling large packs and clearing them with area damage. At that point the nearest rival was still at level 54.

news.title: Hotfixes: Voidwalker health up, Tanning Rack requirement cut
news.summary: The November 6 hotfixes fix a range of class spells and tooltips, raise the Voidwalker's base health, and resolve spawn and leash problems in Maraudon, Blackmaw Hold and The Drowned City. The Tanning Rack now needs skill 125 instead of 140. The update also improves how far away you can see other players and their targets.

news.title: Class tuning set for Tuesday, November 10
news.summary: Blizzard has scheduled class changes for November 10 and may follow up on later Tuesdays. Hunter pets and Warlock Voidwalkers will get tougher, and Affliction damage-over-time spells are being made worth casting next to Wrack. Enhancement Shamans will be tuned so that Strength becomes their main stat.

news.title: Hotfixes: Plainsrunning nerfed in battlegrounds
news.summary: Plainsrunning stacks no longer accumulate, and they now drop off when the player picks up a battleground flag. Zephras Isle trade vendors now sell starter profession bags, and a Druid trainer was added on the island. Several quest NPCs now respawn faster.

news.title: First known-issues list: PvP vendors offline
news.summary: The day after launch, Blizzard posted a short list of known problems. The PvP vendors in Orgrimmar, Stormwind and Dalaran were temporarily unavailable. The list also covered a cauldron in Razorfen Kraul that can trap players, controller and UI bugs, and an Ashenvale quest that was turned off because it caused crashes.

news.title: Launch praised as unusually smooth
news.summary: Press coverage of launch night reported waits of only a few minutes and stable performance, even in crowded starting areas. Writers credited the new mega-server setup for handling the load. A Blizzard vice president described the early hours as going surprisingly well.

news.title: Roaming Orgrimmar vendor sells a wolf pup pet
news.summary: A new wandering vendor in Orgrimmar sells the Prairie Wolf Pup Carrier for 60 silver. She moves around the city, so finding her can take some searching.

news.title: World of Warcraft: Forever is live
news.summary: Forever launched worldwide at 3 p.m. PST on November 4 (23:00 UTC), and all beta and stress-test progress was wiped. New players pick a Classic or Enhanced experience preset, then choose a ruleset rather than a realm. Raids open on December 9, and Hardcore will arrive later.

news.title: Discord guild chat bridge and gamepad improvements
news.summary: Players can now link their Discord and WoW accounts and mirror guild chat in both directions, in Forever and in modern WoW. Blizzard also highlighted improvements to gamepad targeting, casting, looting and menu navigation.

news.title: Twitch drop: Pouch of Violet Dust toy
news.summary: Watching eligible WoW streams between November 4 and November 12 (4:30 p.m. PST) earns the Pouch of Violet Dust toy. It works only in Forever, and only during the launch celebration event. It is removed from collections once the event ends.

news.title: Taldramir revealed as Forever's first legendary
news.summary: About an hour before launch, Blizzard showed Taldramir, the Whispering Wood, as a physical 3D-printed staff during a live stream. A companion video shows Wētā building the prop. Observers expect it to come from the raids that open in December.

news.title: Final pre-launch notes: damage up, mob health up
news.summary: A large set of development notes raised damage for many classes and gave higher-level creatures more health to compensate. Training costs were evened out to about 206 gold in total from 1 to 60. Bags now have to be equipped manually, and respawns in starter zones were sped up for launch.

news.title: Podcast episode 6 covers the tech
news.summary: The sixth official podcast focused on the technology behind Forever, with a guest joining the developers. It was the last episode before launch.

news.title: Fix coming for over-strict name filter
news.summary: The name checker was rejecting valid names that happened to contain certain letter sequences. Blizzard confirmed the bug and said a fix would arrive with realm restarts.

news.title: Early name reservation opens
news.summary: Pack owners could create up to three characters to hold their names before launch, on a first-come, first-served basis. The window ran until November 3. Each name is a first name plus a surname that must be unique within the region.

news.title: Gold for carries must be paid directly
news.summary: Blizzard warned that gold paid for boosts or carries has to go straight from the buyer to the person providing the service. Routing it through a third party may lead to enforcement action.

news.title: Last racial pass before launch
news.summary: A final revision of racial abilities partly reverses the mid-October rework. Weapon-skill racials remain removed.

news.title: Beta ends after five weeks
news.summary: Blizzard closed the beta, thanked testers and said it would focus on the most important issues before launch. On the final day, a one-off celebration took over the starting zones.

news.title: Open stress test for everyone
news.summary: The October 21 stress test needed no subscription or beta invite, so anyone could log in. It ran on production hardware, and all characters and guilds were deleted afterwards ahead of name reservations.

news.title: Camping system explained
news.summary: Cooking fires can be upgraded into campfires where nearby players add profession-made features that give buffs. You have to sit or craft at the camp for a minute to receive them. Larger campfires and high-end features come from later skill levels and from dungeon drops.

news.title: Nine new dungeons and three raids confirmed
news.summary: Blizzard listed nine new five-player dungeons for levels 13 to 60, alongside reworked original dungeons. At 60, Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and a returning Onyxia's Lair (40) will be available.

news.title: Stress test moved to October 21
news.summary: The stress test was pushed back from October 19 to October 21. Blizzard also said that art datamined from recent beta builds is not meant for Forever.

news.title: Beta build reworks racial abilities
news.summary: The October 15 beta build rebuilt many racial traits and made changes to several classes. Some of these changes were later reversed before launch.

news.title: Temporary Economy Holds target gold buyers
news.summary: Accounts suspected of real-money gold trading can be temporarily cut off from trading, mail, guild banks and the Auction House. A hold carries no permanent penalty unless the activity is confirmed.

news.title: Beta build adds Dalaran dungeon, more dungeon XP
news.summary: This build increased experience from dungeons and opened a new Dalaran dungeon for testing. It also adjusted Rage generation and Penance.

news.title: Class deep dives, PvP ranks and Skyborne druid forms
news.summary: Blizzard published deep dives for Mage, Shaman, Rogue and Warlock, and explained PvP progression built on Honor and Rank Points. It also announced revised Skyborne druid forms and said SD versions would come in early 2027.

news.title: Beta level cap rises to 30
news.summary: A beta update raised the level cap to 30 and added another dungeon, along with class tuning and changes to PvP and experience gain. Blizzard also announced a wave of bans for botting and gold selling.

news.title: Class deep dives: Hunter, Druid, Priest, Warrior
news.summary: The first class articles covered changes to Hunter pets and Aimed Shot, Druid forms, Priest baseline abilities, and Warrior Rage. They also confirmed that respecs are now done at class trainers.

news.title: Collector's Edition contents revealed
news.summary: Blizzard listed what is in the physical Collector's Edition, including its digital codes, and gave restock details. It is sold through the Blizzard Gear Store while supplies last.

news.title: Legacy System replaces achievements
news.summary: Completing account-wide challenges earns Legacy Points, which each character spends in its own perk trees for professions, adventure and resourcefulness. At launch there are 65 challenges, and each character can spend up to 16 points. Cosmetic rewards unlock as your total grows.

news.title: Six new race and class combinations
news.summary: Orc Mage, Troll Warlock, Undead Paladin, Human Hunter, Gnome Priest and Dwarf Shaman are all playable in Forever. Several racial traits were updated to fit them.

news.title: Meet the Skyborne
news.summary: The new Skyborne race is descended from Highborne who made a pact with air spirits in Skywall. Players choose the Horde-aligned Windshapers or the Alliance-aligned High Order when creating a character. Both start on Zephras Isle, which covers levels 1 to 12.

news.title: Names now have two parts
news.summary: Every character has a first name and a surname, and the full combination must be unique across the whole region. Filters check both parts together, and surnames can be hidden on nameplates.

news.title: Beta opens
news.summary: The beta began on September 17. Epic Pack and Collection owners had guaranteed access, and others could opt in for a chance to play. Its level cap was later raised to 30.

news.title: Rulesets replace realms
news.summary: Instead of choosing a realm, players pick a ruleset: Normal, PvP, Roleplay or Roleplay PvP, with Hardcore coming later. Grouping, guilds and instances only work within the same ruleset and faction, while battlegrounds can mix rulesets.

news.title: Older graphics cards no longer supported
news.summary: Forever requires at least AMD GCN 1, NVIDIA Maxwell or Intel Skylake graphics, or newer. Blizzard says dropping older cards is what makes the updated visuals possible.

news.title: Forever announced at BlizzCon 2026
news.summary: Blizzard announced World of Warcraft: Forever as a permanent third version of the game that stays at level 60 and adds new zones, dungeons, quests and a new race. It is included with a regular subscription or Game Time. Three Skyborne packs went on sale the same day.

news.title: Roadmap: raids on December 9, more in 2027
news.summary: A BlizzCon panel recap put the first raid unlock on December 9. Hardcore, new raids and dungeons, a revamped classic raid and PvP season refreshes are planned through 2027.

legacy.name: Novice Spelunker
legacy.how: Clear the low-level dungeon group: Ragefire Chasm or Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, Wailing Caverns, Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep and Excavation Site: Wetlands.

legacy.name: Experienced Spelunker
legacy.how: Clear the mid-level dungeon group: City of Dalaran, Blackfathom Deeps, Gnomeregan, The Drowned City, all Scarlet Monastery wings, Razorfen Kraul and Krol'dok Stronghold.

legacy.name: Master Spelunker
legacy.how: Clear the high-level dungeon group: Razorfen Downs, Uldaman, Zul'Farrak, Maraudon, Alcaz Prison, Sunken Temple, BRD, Blackmaw Hold, LBRS/UBRS, Scholomance, Stratholme, Dire Maul and The Shaper's Terrace.

legacy.name: Conqueror of the Lair
legacy.how: Kill Onyxia in Onyxia's Lair.

legacy.name: Holstered Replica Ironforge Air Rifle
legacy.how: Reach 15 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Toy for an opt-in shootout. It only stuns other players who are also holding the rifle, and it counts your hits. Account-wide.

legacy.name: Spectral Bear Cub
legacy.how: Reach 25 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Companion pet. Account-wide.

legacy.name: Spectral Bear Tabard
legacy.how: Reach 40 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Tabard. Account-wide.

legacy.name: Reins of the Spectral Bear
legacy.how: Reach 55 total Legacy Points on your account, then claim it from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet. Ground mount with 100% movement speed. Account-wide.

legacy.name: Professions Legacy Tree
legacy.points: up to 25 per tree; 16 spendable per character at launch
legacy.how: Covers tradeskill and gathering bonuses. Points are earned account-wide, but each character spends its own and can respec at a class trainer.

legacy.name: Adventure Legacy Tree
legacy.points: up to 25 per tree; 16 spendable per character at launch
legacy.how: Covers leveling, travel and out-in-the-world bonuses. Points are earned account-wide, but each character spends its own and can respec at a class trainer.

legacy.name: Resourcefulness Legacy Tree
legacy.points: up to 25 per tree; 16 spendable per character at launch
legacy.how: Covers food, death, reputation, honor and reagent savings. Points are earned account-wide, but each character spends its own and can respec at a class trainer.

legacy.name: Working Overtime
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. Each rank adds 4% to your chance of a skill-up from any primary, secondary or class tradeskill.

legacy.name: Bountiful Harvest
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. Gathering through Mining, Herbalism or Skinning yields more scarce materials, up to 20%.

legacy.name: Bartering
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. Vendors charge 5% less gold.

legacy.name: Performance Bonus
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. When you hand in crates to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics, gives a 5% chance to double the Merchant's Favor you earn.

legacy.name: Master Chef
legacy.points: 1 rank per wiki; 5 per Warcraft Tavern
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. Gives cooking recipes a 10% chance to make an extra item.

legacy.name: Dedicated Study
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. Ability on a daily cooldown that adds one point to your lowest primary or secondary tradeskill. Once all five are at 300, it gives 2-4 random Elemental Essences instead.

legacy.name: Luremaster
legacy.how: Professions tree perk. With a lure active, you have a 25% chance to catch a bonus fish.

legacy.name: Well Rested
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Rested XP builds faster and its cap is higher, by 4% per rank.

legacy.name: Thrill of Adventure
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Killing blows on non-trivial foes restore 1% of your health and mana over 10 seconds. Open world only.

legacy.name: High Alert
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Detect stealth as if you were one level higher. Doesn't work in battlegrounds.

legacy.name: Talented
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Talent points start earlier than level 10, as early as level 5 at full rank. The 51-point cap stays.

legacy.name: Field Guide
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Shortens the cooldown on adding camp features by 8%.

legacy.name: Field Medicine
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Cuts 5 seconds off the Recently Bandaged debuff. Open world only.

legacy.name: Frequent Flier
legacy.points: 3 ranks per wiki; 1 per Warcraft Tavern (needs Field Guide)
legacy.how: Adventure tree perk. Flight paths cost half as much and fly 20% faster.

legacy.name: Gourmand
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Food buffs last 33% longer.

legacy.name: The Quick and the Dead
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Move 5% faster while dead. For 1 minute after resurrecting, or until combat, helpful spells cost nothing.

legacy.name: Reinforce
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Lose 8% less durability when you die.

legacy.name: For Great Honor
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Earn 2% more honor.

legacy.name: Permanence
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Long class party/raid buffs and camp resting benefits last 50% longer.

legacy.name: Diplomat
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Earn 2% more reputation.

legacy.name: Reagent Economy
legacy.points: 1 rank (needs The Quick and the Dead)
legacy.how: Resourcefulness tree perk. Class abilities no longer use vendor-bought reagents.

legacy.name: Unrevealed Professions perks (2)
legacy.how: The Professions tree has two hidden perk slots that Blizzard plans to reveal later.

legacy.name: Unrevealed Adventure perks (2)
legacy.how: The Adventure tree has two hidden perk slots that Blizzard plans to reveal later.

legacy.name: Unrevealed Resourcefulness perks (2)
legacy.how: The Resourcefulness tree has two hidden perk slots that Blizzard plans to reveal later.

pvp.name: Rank 1: Private / Scout
pvp.details: Alliance title Private, Horde title Scout. Ranks reset every season and are climbed with Rank Points; a weekly cap limits how fast you climb, but there is no decay for inactivity.
pvp.requirements: Rank 1 via Rank Points (thresholds not published)
