pvp.name: Weekly rank cap
pvp.details: Beta data shows the highest rank reachable each week of a season: week 1 rank 3, week 2 rank 5, week 3 rank 6, week 4 rank 7, week 5 rank 8, week 6 rank 9, week 7 rank 11, week 8 rank 12, week 9 rank 13, week 10+ rank 14. Blizzard confirmed a weekly cap but not these exact numbers.

pvp.name: Honor
pvp.details: Currency earned from honorable kills, battleground results and PvP quests. Spent on gear; it does not decay. Honor gains were rebalanced so Alterac Valley is no longer the only efficient farm, and featured battlegrounds during holiday weeks give more.

pvp.name: Rank Points
pvp.details: Separate currency that drives rank. Earned from battlegrounds, PvP quests and honorable kills (not from ganking in the open world), boosted in featured battlegrounds.

pvp.name: Blue PvP armour set
pvp.details: Rare-quality PvP set bought with Honor, gated by rank. Shamans get dedicated healer, melee and caster sets.
pvp.requirements: Honor plus the required rank

pvp.name: Epic PvP armour (Emboldened Seal upgrade)
pvp.details: Epic pieces are made by combining the blue piece with an Emboldened Seal, bought with Honor and gated behind higher ranks (ranks 8-13 unlock the slot tokens).
pvp.requirements: Blue piece + Emboldened Seal + rank requirement

pvp.name: Rank 14 epic weapons
pvp.details: Reaching Grand Marshal / High Warlord unlocks the epic PvP weapons; Blizzard says rank 14 is reachable within one season.
pvp.requirements: Rank 14

pvp.name: Marks of Honor
pvp.details: Earned by turning in battleground reputation quests; can be handed in for battleground reputation.

pvp.name: Battle for the Darkspear Islands
pvp.details: New 15v15 battleground off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. Four capture points generate score over time and a central flag carried to a base you hold gives a bonus; first to 2,000 wins. Horde fight as the Darkspear Raiders (base at Merchant Coast), Alliance as the Theramore Expeditionary Force (base at Northwatch); both bases have portals, vendors and quests. Queue from battlemasters in capitals or The Barrens.
pvp.requirements: Levels 30-60
rewards: Darkspear Raiders / Theramore Expeditionary Force reputation
Trinkets, rings, cloaks, weapons and armour by standing

pvp.name: Warsong Gulch
pvp.details: 10v10 capture-the-flag in Ashenvale; returns at launch.
pvp.requirements: Brackets not announced

pvp.name: Arathi Basin
pvp.details: 15v15 resource race over five nodes in Arathi Highlands; returns at launch.
pvp.requirements: Brackets not announced

pvp.name: Alterac Valley
pvp.details: 40v40 large-scale battle in Alterac Mountains; returns at launch with honor rebalanced against other battlegrounds.
pvp.requirements: Brackets not announced

pvp.name: PvP realms
pvp.details: Open-world PvP is always on and each PvP realm is locked to a single faction. Rank only comes from battlegrounds, PvP quests and honorable kills, not from ganking.

pvp.name: Normal realms
pvp.details: PvP is consensual (flag up to fight) and both factions can play on the same realm. Battlegrounds mix players across rulesets except Hardcore, which queues separately.

pvp.name: Field of Honor season journey
pvp.details: Each PvP season has a progression track of weekly quests that give Honor, Rank Points and Legacy Points. Completing the week 4, week 7 and week 10 quests gives a Legacy Point each (3 per season). Rank progress resets each season or content patch; Legacy Points carry over. Season length not announced. No rated PvP or arenas announced.

pvp.name: PvP Legacy challenges
pvp.details: Account-wide Legacy challenges for reaching ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14, and for Exalted with your Darkspear Islands faction.

events.name: Darkmoon Faire
events.when: Monthly, one week from Monday 04:00 realm time. Nov 9-15 2026 (Elwynn), Dec 7-13 2026 (Mulgore), Jan 4-10 2027 (Elwynn)
events.where: Alternates between Goldshire, Elwynn Forest and the foot of Thunder Bluff, Mulgore
events.what: Travelling carnival with games, ticket turn-ins and Sayge's fortunes. Sayge gives one of eight 2-hour buffs (+10% damage, armor, a stat, or +25 resistances). In Forever, world buffs do nothing inside raids but still work in the open world, dungeons and battlegrounds.

events.name: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza
events.when: Weekly on Sundays, starting 14:00 realm time
events.what: Fishing tournament: the first angler to bring 40 Speckled Tastyfish to Riggle Bassbait wins; anyone can also turn in rare fish for prizes.
rewards: Grand prize for the winner (Arcanite Fishing Pole or Glinting Steel Dagger in vanilla)

events.name: Call to Arms (featured battleground)
events.when: Week-long, rotating every 3 weeks: Arathi Basin Nov 3-10, Warsong Gulch Nov 10-17, Darkspear Islands Nov 17-24 2026
events.where: Battlemasters in capitals and The Barrens
events.what: One battleground is highlighted each week with boosted honor and Rank Points.

events.name: Raid launch
events.where: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20), Onyxia's Lair (40)
events.what: All three launch raids unlock on the same day for level 60s, with weekly lockouts.

events.name: Invite-A-Friend launch week
events.what: Players with an Invite-A-Friend code could play Forever without a subscription during launch week.

events.name: Feast of Winter Veil
events.where: Ironforge and Orgrimmar (Greatfather Winter), plus wider Azeroth
events.what: Winter holiday with gift-giving, snowball fights and holiday quests; presents appear under the city trees on Christmas Day.

events.name: Lunar Festival
events.where: Moonglade and Elder locations across Azeroth
events.what: Seek out the Elders around the world for coins, celebrating in Moonglade with feasts and fireworks.

events.name: Love is in the Air
events.what: Exchange gifts and tokens of affection among citizens.

events.name: Noblegarden
events.what: Hunt for brightly coloured eggs hidden in each race's starting area.

events.name: Children's Week
events.what: Adopt an orphan and take them on a sightseeing tour.
rewards: Companion pets from the orphan quests

events.name: Midsummer Fire Festival
events.what: Summer festival with bonfires to honour and to desecrate in each capital and zone.

events.name: Hallow's End
events.what: Trick-or-treat at innkeepers and take part in Halloween festivities.

events.name: Gurubashi Arena chest
events.what: A free-for-all PvP scramble for a chest that drops into the arena.

guides.name: Arms Warrior
guides.summary: Arms swings a slow, heavy two-hander for big hits and good cleave on two or three targets. It's slower-paced because Rage comes from weapon swings, and some of its kit (Spearing Strike, Mortal Strike) leans towards PvP.
statPriority: Hit, since misses deal no damage and give no Rage
Critical Strike (more damage and Rage; Agility adds some)
rotation: Dump spare Rage into Heroic Strike or Cleave
Hamstring only with Rage to spare
guides.talents: Key picks: Bloodthrill, Improved Rend, Improved Overpower, Improved Slam, Mortal Strike, Impale, Two-Handed Specialization and Weaponmaster.
bestRaces: Orc: Attack Power cooldown + passive crit
Troll: attack speed cooldown, bonus vs beasts
Tauren: AoE stun, crit damage, Plainsrunning
guides.forevChanges: Talent builds include 5 extra Legacy talent points. Rend now enables Bloodthrill procs.
tips: Never let Rage cap or hit zero
Keep Rend up at all times for Bloodthrill
Charge in from out of combat for free Rage
Pair Recklessness with big pulls
Blacksmithing + Engineering are the recommended professions

guides.name: Fury Warrior
guides.summary: Fury dual-wields, builds Rage from crits and spends it on Bloodthirst, Whirlwind and Heroic Strike, with strong cooldowns. It shines in PvE cleave fights but gives up survivability, so it's fragile and weak in PvP.
rotation: Dump spare Rage into Heroic Strike or Cleave
Optional: brief stance-dance for Rend and Overpower
guides.talents: Key picks: Cruelty, Unbridled Wrath, Furious Precision, Dual Wield Specialization, Flurry, Enrage, Death Wish and Bloodthirst.
guides.forevChanges: Rend scales better and Overpower costs little, so brief stance-dancing into Battle Stance can be worth it. Death Wish is Fury-only.
tips: Use a slow, heavy main-hand weapon
Don't Heroic Strike if it delays Bloodthirst or Whirlwind
Pair Recklessness with Death Wish for burst
Tell your tank when you'll Whirlwind packs
Berserker Rage breaks Fear and Incapacitate

guides.name: Protection Warrior
guides.summary: The classic plate-and-shield tank, relying on armour, cooldowns and crowd tools rather than mana or forms. Rage comes mostly from being hit, so it can run dry when nothing is hitting you.
statPriority: Hit, so swings land and make Rage
Stamina, armour and avoidance, balanced with threat stats
rotation: Dump spare Rage into Heroic Strike or Cleave
Keep Thunder Clap and Demoralizing Shout up
guides.talents: Key picks: Shield Specialization, Anticipation and Deflection (feeding Master of Defense), Bastion, Cruelty, Improved Revenge, Defiance, Last Stand, Improved Shield Wall, Shield Slam and Vanguard (Charge in Defensive Stance).
bestRaces: Dwarf: Stoneform defensive cooldown + crit damage
Night Elf: crit cooldown, dodge, speed
Orc: Attack Power cooldown, magic defensive
guides.forevChanges: Shields are genuinely worth using in Forever for threat and survival, unlike other Classic versions. Vanguard lets you Charge in Defensive Stance.
tips: Charge to open pulls for instant Rage
Challenging Shout keeps aggro through taunt immunity
Keep Sunder, Thunder Clap, Demo Shout and Rend running
Use Bloodrage freely
Wear Mail until 40, then Plate

guides.name: Balance Druid
guides.summary: No longer a joke spec: Balance is a solid caster DPS using DoTs and hard casts, plus buffs, debuffs and emergency healing. Eclipse gives it a satisfying Starfire/Wrath rhythm.
statPriority: Hit (Nature's Reach covers a lot early)
rotation: 2-4 targets: DoT everything, filler on priority target
Refresh DoTs or Faerie Fire while moving
guides.talents: Standard 41/0/10: Improved Wrath, Moonglow and Eclipse, plus Genesis, Insect Swarm, Improved Starfire and Moonkin Form.
guides.forevChanges: Eclipse adds a Wrath/Starfire rhythm, Hurricane has no cooldown, and DoTs update dynamically with buffs (no snapshotting).
tips: Don't clip DoTs
Skip DoTs on mobs about to die
Spend Clearcasting on Starfire
Don't downrank
Save Innervate for a healer in endgame

guides.name: Feral Druid
guides.summary: Feral can deal melee damage in Cat Form or tank in Bear Form, and both are viable. Far fewer awkward mechanics than in Classic, but juggling forms and resources still takes skill.
rotation: Ferocious Bite at 4-5 combo points with 70+ Energy
Refresh Rake right after it drops
Shifting Power on cooldown under 50 Energy
Build combo points with Shred (Claw if you can't get behind)
guides.talents: Hybrid 9/37/5 for both cat DPS and bear tanking: Feral Charge, Lacerate, Predatory Discipline, Leader of the Pack, Shifting Power and Primal Bite.
bestRaces: Tauren: AoE stun usable in form, extra health
guides.forevChanges: Powershifting and bear-weaving are gone, so stay in one form. You can now use consumables and talk to most NPCs without leaving form.
tips: Refresh bleeds just after they expire
Stay behind targets for Shred
Cower to drop threat
Turn on the Personal Resource Display to see mana in form
Feral Charge closes gaps and interrupts

guides.name: Restoration Druid
guides.summary: Heals mostly with heal-over-time spells on one or several targets. It needs more planning than other healers because HoTs go out in advance, but brings great utility.
rotation: Swiftmend a target that already has Rejuvenation or Regrowth
Wild Growth when several people take damage
Rejuvenation on anyone under sustained damage
Healing Touch at a rank that covers the gap
Nature's Swiftness for an instant big heal
guides.talents: Standard 13/0/38: Reflection for mana, Bloom for extra healing when HoTs expire, Wild Growth.
guides.forevChanges: New Wild Growth AoE HoT, Swiftmend no longer eats your HoT, Reflection is buffed, a new out-of-combat rez (Revive), and Faerie Fire for Restoration.
tips: Don't clip HoTs
Downrank Healing Touch to save mana
Turn on mouseover casting
Only start Tranquility if you can channel it fully
Bring a Camping crit buff if you're the only Druid

guides.name: Beast Mastery Hunter
guides.summary: Your pet does a big share of the damage and can tank pulls, which makes Beast Mastery excellent for solo play. Its weakness is relying on the pet staying alive and on target.
statPriority: Hit (9% at 300 weapon skill, 6% at 305, vs level 63 bosses)
Critical Strike (pets inherit all of it)
rotation: Pre-place Immolation Trap where the tank will stand
Pre-cast Aimed Shot, then use it on cooldown
Summon Hawk on cooldown, keep two out
Arcane Shot once two Hawks are up
Rapid Fire and Bestial Wrath on cooldown
AoE: Multi-Shot, Explosive Trap, spread Serpent Sting
guides.talents: 31/20/0: Bestial Discipline, Bestial Wrath, Careful Aim (Intellect to AP), Focused Fire, Unleashed Fury, Ferocity and Frenzy.
bestRaces: Troll: attack speed, bonus vs beasts
guides.forevChanges: New spells and talents, consolidated Classic talents, reworked Bestial Discipline; Scorpid Sting now lowers the target's hit chance by 2% for 20 sec.
tips: Use Stay and Move To to keep your pet safe
Mind the dead zone between melee and 8 yards
Don't move unnecessarily (it breaks Auto Shot)
Stay in Aspect of the Hawk
Tranquilizing Shot removes Enrage/Frenzy
Feign Death to reset bad pulls

guides.name: Marksmanship Hunter
guides.summary: Strong long-range damage, with or without a pet: the new Lone Wolf talent trades your pet for more personal damage in endgame PvE. The rotation is simple; positioning, mana and cooldown timing matter.
rotation: Pre-cast Sniper Shot, then use it on cooldown
AoE: Multi-Shot, Serpent Sting on all, Explosive Trap
guides.talents: 5/46/0: Lethal Attacks, Barrage, Careful Aim, Rapid Recuperation for mana, Sniper Shot; Lone Wolf (swap for Improved Tracking to keep a pet).
guides.forevChanges: New Lone Wolf talent (give up your pet for damage) and new top-tier Sniper Shot ability.
tips: Stay in Aspect of the Hawk
Keep Auto Shot going: avoid needless movement
Sniper Shot and Aimed Shot are mana-hungry
Keep Feign Death ready when petless
Stable a few pets for tough solo content

guides.name: Survival Hunter
guides.summary: Survival weaves melee into its ranged rotation or fights fully in melee, with new talents boosting melee strikes and traps. Demanding positioning and timing, but high damage potential.
rotation: Back to range and repeat shots
guides.talents: 5/13/33: Savage Strikes, Clever Traps, Resourcefulness, Careful Aim; Lone Wolf (or Efficiency / Improved Stings to keep a pet).
guides.forevChanges: New melee and trap talents, consolidated Classic talents, reworked Scorpid Sting (lowers enemy hit chance).
tips: Reach the hit cap
Take Resourcefulness for mana while weaving
Stay in Hawk or Beast aspect, not travel aspects
Keep your quiver/ammo pouch upgraded

guides.requirement: Cooking 220; Thick Logs; Expert Campfire blueprint

guides.name: Cookie's Feast
guides.summary: A feast that gives a Stamina buff.
guides.requirement: Cooking 140; 2 Mystery Meat, Heavy Kodo Meat, Soothing Spices; blueprint drops from Cookie in The Deadmines

guides.name: Iron Oven
guides.summary: Workstation for some Cooking recipes.
guides.requirement: Cooking 300; 10 Simple Flour, 5 Refreshing Spring Water, 4 Soothing Spices; Iron Oven blueprint

guides.name: Enchanted Lute
guides.summary: Stats and resistances, like Mark of the Wild (doesn't stack).
guides.requirement: Enchanting 20; Simple Wood + Strange Dust; Camping 101: Enchanting quest or trainer

guides.name: Arcane Salvager
guides.summary: Improves disenchanting.
guides.requirement: Enchanting 140; 2 Vision Dust, Lesser Nether Essence; blueprint drops in Ruins of Lordaeron, City of Dalaran or Razorfen Kraul

guides.name: Arcane Forge
guides.summary: Workstation for certain Enchanting formulas.
guides.requirement: Enchanting 300; Maker's Spark, 2 Large Brilliant Shard, 4 Greater Eternal Essence; Arcane Forge blueprint

guides.name: Repair Bot

guides.requirement: Engineering 140; 2 Whirring Bronze Gizmo, Bronze Tube, Heavy Leather, Arclight Spanner; blueprint drops from Sneed in The Deadmines

guides.name: Anarchist's Workbench
guides.summary: Workstation for some Engineering schematics.
guides.requirement: Engineering 300; Essence of Anarchy, 2 Thorium Widget, Arclight Spanner; Anarchist's Workbench blueprint

guides.name: First Aid Kit
guides.summary: Stamina, like Power Word: Fortitude (doesn't stack).
guides.requirement: First Aid 20; 3 Linen Bandage + Refreshing Spring Water; Camping 101: First Aid quest or trainer

guides.name: Toxin Study

guides.requirement: First Aid 140; Anti-Venom, 2 Mageweave Bandage, 2 Simple Wood; blueprint drops from Commander Springvale in Shadowfang Keep

guides.name: Plague Doctor's Laboratory
guides.summary: Provides healing potions and poultices.
guides.requirement: First Aid 300; 2 Simple Wood, 2 Strong Anti-Venom, 5 Heavy Runecloth Bandage; blueprint

guides.name: Fish Bowl
guides.summary: All stats, like Blessing of Kings (doesn't stack).
guides.requirement: Fishing 20; Raw Brilliant Smallfish + Empty Vial; Camping 101: Fishing quest or trainer

guides.name: Fishing Rack
guides.summary: Better nearby fishing: lures and Uncommon fish.
guides.requirement: Fishing 140; 2 Simple Wood, Crystal Vial, 2 Raw Mithril Head Trout; blueprint from Gelihast in Blackfathom Deeps or fishing pools

guides.name: Fishing Hut
guides.summary: Better nearby fishing: lures and Rare fish.
guides.requirement: Fishing 300; 5 Simple Wood, 2 Bolt of Runecloth, Seasonal Fish Steaks; blueprint

guides.name: Incense Candle

guides.requirement: Herbalism 20; Peacebloom + Silverleaf; Camping 101: Herbalism quest or trainer

guides.name: Greenhouse
guides.summary: Plant seeds and grow your own herbs.
guides.requirement: Herbalism 140; 2 Simple Wood, Arthas' Tears, Purple Lotus; blueprint drops from Shadetooth in Excavation Site: Wetlands

guides.name: Seed Hybridizer
guides.summary: Multiplies seeds or turns them into rarer ones.
guides.requirement: Herbalism 300; Crystal Vial, 2 Runecloth, 4 Mountain Silversage; blueprint

guides.name: Camp Tent
guides.summary: Grants Rested XP worth 5% of a level (1-hour lockout).
guides.requirement: Leatherworking 20; 5 Light Leather; Camping 101: Leatherworking quest or trainer

guides.name: Tanning Rack
guides.summary: Workstation for certain materials.
guides.requirement: Leatherworking 140; 5 Medium Leather, 3 Fine Thread, 2 Simple Wood; blueprint drops from Razorclaw the Butcher in Shadowfang Keep

guides.name: Sewing Machine
guides.summary: Workstation for some patterns.
guides.requirement: Leatherworking 300; Undeath Engine, 5 Rugged Leather, Rune Thread; blueprint

guides.name: Lodestone
guides.summary: Attack power, like Blessing of Might (doesn't stack).
guides.requirement: Mining 20; Rough Stone + Copper Bar; Camping 101: Mining quest or trainer

guides.name: Rock Garden
guides.summary: Slowly spawns a common ore node.
guides.requirement: Mining 140; 2 Heavy Stone, Iron Ore, Silver Bar; blueprint drops from Relic Guardian in Excavation Site: Wetlands

guides.name: Molten Foundry
guides.summary: Workstation for some smelting recipes.
guides.requirement: Mining 300; 5 Thorium Bar, 2 Dense Stone, Truesilver Bar; blueprint

guides.requirement: Skinning 20; 3 Light Leather, 2 Simple Wood; Camping 101: Skinning quest or trainer

guides.name: Field Guide
guides.summary: Track nearby beasts on the minimap.
guides.requirement: Skinning 140; 3 Medium Leather, 2 Slimy Murloc Scale, Fine Thread; blueprint drops from Lady Anacondra in Wailing Caverns

guides.name: Trapper's Workbench
guides.summary: Provides a trap.
guides.requirement: Skinning 300; 2 Simple Wood, 4 Heavy Leather, Iron Bar; blueprint

guides.name: Faction Banner
guides.summary: Spirit, like Divine Spirit (doesn't stack).
guides.requirement: Tailoring 20; Bolt of Linen Cloth + Coarse Thread; Camping 101: Tailoring quest or trainer
