guides.name: Loom
guides.summary: Workstation for some patterns.
guides.requirement: Tailoring 300; Bottled Screams, 4 Bolt of Runecloth, 4 Simple Wood; blueprint

guides.name: Scarlet Banner
guides.summary: A cosmetic camp object with no buff.
guides.requirement: Solve a multi-zone puzzle tied to Scarlet Monastery

guides.name: Camping
guides.summary: Build a campfire, then party members place profession-made camp objects around it. Sit within range for a minute to get all their buffs, crafting stations, vendors and Rested XP. Higher-tier campfires hold more objects.
steps: Learn Cooking (needed to make the campfire)
Gather Flint and Tinder plus Simple Wood (Basic), Star Wood (Journeyman, skill 140) or Thick Logs (Expert, skill 220)
Craft and place the campfire: it burns about 10 minutes, with a 5-minute cooldown
Each character places one camp object (1-hour cooldown)
/sit inside the radius for a minute to get the buffs
tips: Camp buffs are slightly weaker than class buffs and don't stack with them, but replace them
Rest again to add new objects' effects without losing old ones
Hover the Camp Benefits buff to see what you have
Cozy Sleeping Bag and food XP bonus stack with camp buffs
Legacy talents: Field Guide (shorter cooldown), Permanence (longer buffs), Reagent Economy (free basic objects)

guides.name: Library Books
guides.summary: Books scattered around the world that you hand to a librarian for jewellery and other rewards at 10, 20 and 25 books.
steps: Turn them in to Garon Wendell (Stormwind) or Owen Thadd (Undercity)
10 books: Scholarly Pendant or Erudite's Amulet
20 books (level 20): Field Researcher's Loop or Philanthropist's Ring
25 books (level 30): Truthseeker's Bow, Crest of Elucidation or Researcher's Night Light
books: Archmage Theocritus's Research Journal: Elwynn Forest, top of the Tower of Azora
Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography: Ironforge, Hall of Explorers back room
The Lessons of Ta'zo: Orgrimmar, Valley of Spirits painted rock
The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer: Brill alchemy shop
Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities: The Sepulcher, Silverpine
The Dalaran Digest, Vol. 23: Ambermill town hall, Silverpine
Nar'thalas Almanac, Vol. 74: Ruins of Mathystra, Darkshore
Rumi of Gnomeregan: Thelsamar inn or Sentinel Hill inn (only once)
Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings: Mo'grosh Stronghold cave, Loch Modan
Bewitchments and Glamours: Moonbrook, Westfall
Arcanic Systems Manual: Sludge Fen, The Barrens
Baxtan: On Destructive Magics: Ratchet engineering shop
Secrets of the Dreamers: Cavern of Mists, The Barrens
Fury of the Land: Grimtotem Post, Stonetalon
Crimes Against Anatomy: Raven Hill Cemetery catacombs, Duskwood
Goaz Scrolls: Whelgar's Excavation Site, Wetlands
Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth: Darkcloud Pinnacle, Thousand Needles
Defensive Magics 101: ogre fortress tower, Alterac Mountains
A Web of Lies: Witherbark Village, Arathi
Demons and You: Thunder Axe Fortress, Desolace
Basilisks: Should Petrification be Feared?: Stranglethorn cave entrance
Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead: Badlands crypt
RwlRwlRwlRwl!: east of the murloc camp, Dustwallow Marsh
A Ludite's Guide to Caring for Your Demonic Pet: Fallow Sanctuary, Swamp of Sorrows
Sanguine Sorcery: atop the Sunken Temple
The Liminal and the Arcane: the Nightmare, Feralas
Legends of the Tidesages: pirate bookshelf, Tanaris
Venomous Journeys: The Hinterlands (36, 73)
A Mind of Metal: Searing Gorge (37, 49)
Conjurer's Codex: Blasted Lands (55, 32)
Everyday Etiquette: Heldarr Encampment, Azshara
Northern Kalimdor - A Comprehensive Guide: Timbermaw Hold, Felwood
Magma or Lava?: near the Blackrock Depths entrance
Necromancy 101: Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
Undead Potatoes: Felstone Field, Western Plaguelands
Stonewrought Design: Blackrock Depths, near Franclorn Forgewright
A Study of the Light: Light's Hope Chapel
Scourge: Undead Menace or Misunderstood?: near Stratholme
The Knight and the Lady: central lake, Eastern Plaguelands
Ka-Boom!: Everlook, behind the alchemy vendor
tips: Turn books in as you go
Group nearby books into one trip
Opposite-faction zones are hardest; many players skip those books

guides.name: Transmog & outfits
guides.summary: Change how your gear looks using appearances you've collected, account-wide. You can only transmog to the same armour type. Two Outfit slots are free; more cost 1g up to 100g.
steps: Visit a Transmogrifier: Fyrenz Vishonar (Stormwind Mage District 48, 84), Mon'ye (Orgrimmar Cleft of Shadows 46, 54) or Spellweaver Thaldris (Dalaran 18, 61, Alliance)
Unlock looks from quest rewards, gear you collect (BoE needs binding or selling) and group loot rolls
Apply looks per slot, same armour type
Save Outfits and swap freely out of combat
Optionally switch outfits automatically by zone, spec, weather or time of day
tips: A quest reward unlocks every reward option's appearance
Being present for a group loot roll unlocks it even if you lose
Transmog stays on the slot when you equip an upgrade
Turn transmog off for free to see real gear

guides.name: Legacy system
guides.summary: Forever's seasonal replacement for achievements. Complete Legacy Challenges to earn Legacy Points (capped at 16 per season at launch), spend them in three trees for permanent bonuses, and unlock seasonal cosmetics at 15, 25, 40 and 55 total points.
steps: Unlock it with level 25 or 150 in a crafting profession (press Y)
1 point each for levels 25, 45 and 60 on every class
1 point each for 150, 225 and 300 in Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking or Tailoring
PvP: honour ranks 3, 7, 10, 13 and 14; Exalted with a battleground faction (one point total); weeks 4, 7 and 10 of the Field of Honor Journey
Explore Azeroth, and the An Earnest Proposition to Saving the Best for Last questline
1 point per dungeon group: Novice, Experienced and Master Spelunker
1 point per raid fully cleared: Hyjal Summit, Barrow Deeps, Onyxia's Lair
guides.talents: Professions: Working Overtime (+4% skill-up chance x5), Bountiful Harvest (+20% Scarce materials x5), Luremaster, Performance Bonus, Bartering (-5% vendor prices x2), Master Chef, Dedicated Study. Adventure: Well Rested (+4% rested gain and cap x5), Thrill of Adventure, Field Medicine, Field Guide, Talented (talents from level 9, down to 5), High Alert, Frequent Flier (50% cheaper, 20% faster flights). Resourcefulness: Gourmand (+33% food buff duration), The Quick and the Dead, Reinforce, Diplomat (+2% reputation x5), Permanence (+50% class buff and camp duration), For Great Honor, Reagent Economy (no vendor reagents).
tips: Claim cosmetic rewards from Innkeeper Wiley in Ratchet
Hardcore points work on normal characters, not the other way round
Maxing the system is a long-term goal, not a per-season one

guides.name: Riding & mounts
guides.summary: Mounts unlock at level 40 with one universal Riding skill from your own race's trainer; riding another race's mount needs Exalted with them.
steps: Apprentice Riding: level 40, 100g training, 20g mount, 60% speed
Journeyman Riding: level 60, 1,000g training, 200g mount, 100% speed
Honored with your home faction: 10% off training and mounts
guides.trainers: Randal Hunter, Elwynn Forest (84, 65) · Jartsam, Darnassus (38, 16) · Ultham Ironhorn, Dun Morogh (64, 50) · Binjy Featherwhistle, Dun Morogh (49, 48) · Genn Fairweather, Zephras Isle (54, 81) for both Skyborne · Kildar, Orgrimmar (69, 13) · Xar'Ti, Durotar (55, 76) · Kar Stormsinger, Mulgore (47, 62) · Velma Warnam, Tirisfal Glades (60, 52)
tips: Paladins and Warlocks get riding and their class mounts through class quests
Humans have a second mount vendor in Menethil Harbor (Wetlands 9, 54)

guides.name: Weapon trainers
guides.summary: Weapon Masters teach the weapon skills your class can use. Most skills cost 10 silver; Polearms need level 20 and cost 1 gold.
guides.trainers: Ilyenia Moonfire (Darnassus, Warrior's Terrace): bows, daggers, fist, staves, thrown · Buliwyf Stonehand (Ironforge Military Ward): fist, guns, axes, maces · Bixi Wobblebonk (Ironforge): crossbows, daggers, thrown · Woo Ping (Stormwind Trade District): crossbows, daggers, swords, polearms, staves · Sayoc (Orgrimmar Valley of Honor): bows, daggers, fist, axes, staves, thrown · Hanashi (Orgrimmar): bows, axes, staves, thrown · Ansekhwa (Thunder Bluff Lower Rise): guns, maces, staves · Archibald (Undercity War Quarter): crossbows, daggers, swords, polearms
tips: Wands are automatic for Mages, Priests and Warlocks
Some classes can use weapons Classic didn't allow, e.g. Rogues with one-handed axes
Druids get Feral Combat from level 1

guides.name: Experience & Rested XP
guides.summary: XP comes from quests, kills, exploring and dungeons; level 60 takes 4,084,700 XP in total. Rested XP, Well Fed food, the Camp Tent and the Cozy Sleeping Bag all boost it and stack.
steps: Grey quests (5+ levels below) give 10-20% less XP per extra level
Grey mobs give no XP; first tag gets credit
Full 5-player group: kill XP divided by 5 and multiplied by 1.4 (100 XP solo = 28 each)
Quest turn-in XP isn't reduced by grouping
Rested XP doubles kill XP; builds 5% of a level per 8 hours in inns/cities, capped at 150% (about 10 days)
Well Rested Legacy talent: +4% rest gain and cap per rank
Well Fed: +5% kill XP for about 15 minutes (lost on death)
Cozy Sleeping Bag: up to 3% XP, kept through death
Camp Tent: 1-hour buff that persists through death
High-level group members now carry stronger XP penalties in dungeons
tips: Log out in inns or cities
Pick up dungeon quests before going in
Keep Cooking levelled for constant Well Fed

guides.name: Best hunter pets
guides.summary: No single pet suits everything: families differ in damage, survivability and utility. These are the recommended picks by activity.
steps: Levelling: Cat for fast, strong damage (less durable later), or Boar for durability and Charge
Raids and dungeons: Cat for top damage, or Wolf for Furious Howl (party melee AP) and 1.2 sec attack speed
PvP: Broken Tooth (rare cat, Badlands, 1.0 sec attack speed, about 7-8 hour respawn), Wind Serpent (Lightning Breath ignores armour, ranged)
Organised PvP: Crocolisk (Dismember healing reduction), Bat (Sonic Blast vs casters), Bird of Prey (Mine! disarm)
Solo endgame: Wolf (Furious Howl threat) or Boar (survives sustained damage)
tips: Wolves are great in groups without a Warrior's Battle Shout
Expect competition for Broken Tooth

guides.name: Hunter pet loyalty & training
guides.summary: Pets earn Loyalty as you adventure together, from Rebellious to Best Friend. Loyalty gives Training Points, spent in Beast Training to learn and rank up abilities; feeding and killing with your pet raises Loyalty and keeps it happy.
steps: Loyalty ranks: Rebellious, Unruly, Submissive, Dependable, Faithful, Best Friend
Feed your pet and kill mobs together to raise Loyalty
A level 60 Best Friend pet has 300 Training Points
High-level tames can start with negative Training Points
Learn active abilities by taming a pet that has them and using them in combat until you see the 'learned' message
Pets can have at most four active abilities
Pet Trainers teach passives (Great Stamina, Natural Armor, resistances) and Growl (every 10 levels)
tips: Check the Pet Trainer every level
Resetting abilities costs a small fee
After learning from a temporary pet, abandon or stable it before training your main pet

guides.name: Zephras Isle walkthrough (Skyborne 1-12)
guides.summary: The Skyborne starting island, from Thendal Village through Shen'dar Village, Valanaar and Shadowgale Forest to the showdown with the Al'Aketh cult.
steps: Coming of Age (Ailee Farheart), Harmony in Balance and Infestation Investigation in Thendal Grove
Harvesting Windstones (15 Windstone Clusters) earns a gathering profession voucher
Elemental Unrest in the northern valley; touch the Leyline and Elemental Convergences for a racial buff
Foul Matriarch and Aggressive Encroachment: Urs'anah in the bear cave (38, 27), group advised
Al'Aketh Thugs and Malduko Cloudcrush in the south-west ruins
The Adventurer tent (42, 45) and The Great Outdoors (Raan Wildwind)
Faction Elder: Illaya Amberwind (Horde) or Rathiril Sunlance (Alliance)
Highlands Bandits and Badwind Bennic in the west
Hippogryph Harassment and A Little Beauty; Matriarch at (35, 54)
Elite Vulgara from the north side of her hill (43, 52), soloable around level 7
Infiltrating the Cult at Falaath Village: Stormcallers and Commander Cyclas
To Valanaar and Deliver the Signet
Gustberry Lowlands faction chains and Crab Season
Windfield Orchard quests with Aamelia Windfield
Shadowgale Forest chains, then the Nightclaw Cavern healing quest and the final battle
tips: Walk on Air and Blessing of Zephras tornadoes (40% speed) for fast travel
Windstones heal and restore mana on Zephras Isle
Don't jump off the wind bridge until the wind appears
Wait for talk-and-wait scenes to finish

guides.name: Skyborne (new race)
guides.summary: An elf race descended from Highborne who hid in the Skywall and took up air magic. Alliance Skyborne are the High Order; Horde Skyborne are Windshapers. They start on Zephras Isle and need a WoW Forever upgrade pack.
steps: Unlocked by the Heroic Pack, Epic Pack, Warcraft Forever Collection or Collector's Edition
High Order (Alliance) classes: Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue, Warrior
Windshaper (Horde) classes: Druid, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warrior
Start in Thendal Village, Zephras Isle (to about level 12-14)
Riding and Galestrider mounts at Fairweather Stables (54, 81)
Skycutter ship from Valanaar to Dalaran (Alliance) or Thunder Bluff (Horde)
tips: Racials include Walk on Air (steerable slow fall), Wind Blessed (haste), Elemental Insight, plus Read Ley Line (High Order mana cooldown) or Skysight (Windshaper speed)
Faction reputation discounts mounts and riding: 5% at Friendly up to 20% at Exalted
Skyborne can speak Darnassian across factions

guides.name: Rulesets & realm types
guides.summary: Five rulesets: Normal, PvP, Roleplay, RP-PvP and Hardcore. Each region has one realm per ruleset, and characters can't move or play between rulesets, so pick the same one as your friends.
steps: Normal: standard PvE, no special rules
PvP: auto-flagged outside your faction's zones, no ganking limits; one faction per account, forced population balance
Roleplay: lore-friendly names enforced; roleplay itself optional; both factions
RP-PvP: Roleplay + PvP rules, one faction
Hardcore (after launch): permanent death; dead characters can transfer out; doesn't use Legacy or Collections from elsewhere, but its progress counts for other rulesets
tips: On PvP and RP-PvP you can only make characters on one faction
Legacy and Collections are account-wide except on Hardcore

guides.name: Race & class combinations
guides.summary: Forever gives six Classic races a new class, and Skyborne classes depend on faction. Only Tauren and Night Elves gained nothing new.
steps: Dwarf (Alliance): Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Shaman (new), Warrior
Gnome (Alliance): Mage, Priest (new), Rogue, Warlock, Warrior
Human (Alliance): Hunter (new), Mage, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Warlock, Warrior
Night Elf (Alliance): Druid, Hunter, Priest, Rogue, Warrior
Skyborne High Order (Alliance): Druid, Hunter, Mage, Rogue, Warrior
Orc (Horde): Hunter, Mage (new), Rogue, Shaman, Warlock, Warrior
Troll (Horde): Hunter, Mage, Priest, Rogue, Shaman, Warlock (new), Warrior
Undead (Horde): Mage, Paladin (new), Priest, Rogue, Warlock, Warrior
Skyborne Windshaper (Horde): Druid, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warrior
tips: Gnome Priests get two new racials: Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan

guides.name: Rogue poisons
guides.summary: Unlocked through a faction questline from level 20, then applied to weapons (two at a time). In Forever, poisons scale with Attack Power, can crit, and stack with sharpening stones and Windfury Totem.
steps: Instant Poison: unlocked by the Alliance or Horde poison questline
Crippling Poison: Rogue trainer from level 20
Deadly Poison: from level 30 (30% chance to apply)
tips: Have 80 Lockpicking before starting the questline (level 22 is comfortable for Vanish and Distract)
The Horde questline is much harder than the Alliance one
Opening the Klaven's Tower / Venture Co. chest gives Touch of Zanzil: cure with Anti-Venom, a Shaman/Druid, or the follow-up quest
Poison skill rises 1 per poison, capped at 5x your level
Shady Dealers sell all the materials

guides.name: Rogue lockpicking 1-300
guides.summary: Trained from level 16 with Thieves' Tools; the cap is 5x your level, so 300 needs level 60.
route: 1-110: the Alliance (Redridge, then Lake Everstill footlockers) or Horde (Ratchet, Merchant Coast pirate boat, then Zoram Strand footlockers) questline
110-150: Battered Footlockers in Windshear Mine (Horde), Durnholde Keep (both) or the murloc camps NE of Menethil (Alliance)
150-200: Waterlogged Footlockers at Sar'theris Strand, Desolace (Water Breathing helps); or Mossy Footlockers at Atal'Hakkar after 175; or Angor Fortress, Badlands
200-250: The Slag Pits, Searing Gorge (upper levels after 225), pickpocketing for extra boxes
250-280: Scarlet Footlockers at Tyr's Hand, Eastern Plaguelands (dangerous elites)
280-300: the doors in Blackrock Depths, resetting the instance to repeat
tips: Thieves' Tools aren't used up
Pick Pocket mid-to-high level mobs for strongboxes
Offer to open lockboxes in city trade chat

guides.name: Nightclaw Druids reputation
guides.summary: A neutral Zephras Isle faction. Earn reputation from the Shadowgale Forest storyline, then by handing in Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears. Vayn Moongaze (den entrance, 64, 36) sells level 7-10 Skyborne-style armour recipes, a pet and a shoulder transmog.
steps: Neutral to mid-Friendly: Unnerving Silence (Lotheluum Starbreeze, Valanaar), then the Shadowgale Forest storyline (starts with Elegael Thornpaw behind a tree at 61.8, 39.1)
Then Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears (Vayn Moongaze): hand in 10 ears to unlock the repeatable
Friendly onward: More Al'Aketh Ears, 5 ears for 200 rep
About 75 ears to Friendly, 150 to Honored, 300 to Revered, 525 to Exalted
keyGear: Friendly: Blacksmithing Cloudy/Azure Skyforged plans, Leatherworking Gustwoven/Windraveled patterns, Tailoring Stormsewn patterns
Honored: more plans (legguards, chainmail, harness, trousers, jerkin, vest, leggings)
Revered: Shadowgale Squirrel pet
Exalted: Nightclaw Mantle transmog and the '...of the Nightclaw' title

guides.name: Skyborne Druid form quests
guides.summary: Skyborne Druids earn Bear Form at 10 on Zephras Isle, and Cat Form at 20 through a chain via Moonglade.
steps: 10 · The Great Ursera Spirit: Lotheluum Starbreeze, Valanaar (64, 75); meet the bear spirit on the east island
10 · Strength and Mercy: Urs'endris (70, 62); kill the mad Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands cave (54, 65) → Bear Form, Growl, Maul
20 · The Great Cat Spirit: Mathrengyl Bearwalker (Darnassus 35, 8) or Turak Runetotem (Thunder Bluff 77, 28)
20 · The Great Windborne Cat Spirit: Dendrite Starblaze, Nighthaven (56, 31)
20 · Speak to the Avatar of Saeyleenan (Moonglade 44, 74); click the cat statue inside the barrow den (72, 62) for stealth
20 · Collect the Relics of the Claw, Fang and Silent Shadow from the cat statues; return to the Avatar
20 · Final quest from Dendrite Starblaze, hand in at your Druid trainer → Cat Form, Claw, Prowl, Rip
tips: Use Teleport: Moonglade

guides.name: Dwarf Shaman totem quests
guides.summary: Dwarf Shamans (new in Forever) unlock their four totems through one quest per element.
steps: 4 · Call of Earth: Teo Hammerstorm, Anvilmar; 2 Iceclaw Bear Pendants from Frostmane Troll Whelps; drink Earth Sapta at the Earth Spirit Stone (25, 62) → Earth Totem, Stoneskin Totem

10 · Call of Fire: Bruegs Kindleborn (path from 87, 47 in Dun Morogh), then Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan (32, 66); Fire Tar and a Reagent Pouch; drink Fire Sapta on the peak (32, 65), defeat the fire manifestation → Fire Totem, Searing Totem

20 · Call of Water: Norric Lochthane (Loch Modan 42, 19), Hervdana Saegrund's cave (Wetlands 66, 76); fill waterskins at Stonewatch Falls (Redridge 74, 62) and near Astranaar (Ashenvale 37, 52); drink Water Sapta at the Forgotten Shrine, Westfall (48, 60) → Water Totem, Healing Stream Totem
30 · Call of Air: from your trainer; Veyric Thundervein, Arathi Highlands (60, 28), via the rocky path near the Shard of Myzrael → Air Totem
tips: Fire quest mobs reach level 14: group up
The Water quest is a long trip: use flight paths, hearth and the Menethil-Darkshore boat

guides.name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
guides.summary: A treasure-trail item: lie on it for up to 3 Well-Rested stacks (+1% XP each, kept through death). It counts as a rested area, the whole party can use it, and it has a 1-hour cooldown.
steps: Alliance: Nailed Plank at Alexston Farmstead, Westfall (37, 50)
Burned-Out Remains in the southern Barrens (46, 74), then Stepping Stones
Pocket Litter at the hillside camp near Sun Rock Retreat, Stonetalon; optionally rekindle the campfire; then the Mound of Dirt just east
Carved Figurine on a ledge of the Stonewrought Dam, Loch Modan (49, 12)
Hillsbrad: climb the leaning cart at the gap in the Thoradin Wall, then click the Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel → Cozy Sleeping Bag
Horde: same objects, starting in The Barrens, then Westfall, Stonetalon, Loch Modan, Hillsbrad
tips: Lie down for about 3 minutes for all 3 stacks
It vanishes if you move about 100 yards away
Stacks with Camping buffs and food

guides.name: Scarlet Banner puzzle
guides.summary: A cosmetic camp banner: collect four Echoes from graves, then activate them at the matching statues in the Scarlet Monastery Library.
steps: Arathi Echo: grave behind the barn at Go'shek Farm, Arathi Highlands (62, 55)
Theramore Echo: Theramore Graveyard across the bridge, Dustwallow Marsh (64, 42)
Swamp Echo: grave by a tree at Splinterspear Junction, Swamp of Sorrows (17, 54)
Graveyard Echo: back corner near the south mausoleum inside SM Graveyard
In SM Library, find the four statues
Blake Godwyn (warrior): use the Swamp Echo
Brother Paxwell (priest): Graveyard Echo → Scarlet Banner
tips: Standing near a statue gives a buff naming it
Wrong order means resetting the dungeon

guides.name: Zephras Isle to Ironforge (Alliance Skyborne)
guides.summary: How a new High Order Skyborne gets from Zephras Isle to the Alliance capitals.
steps: Go to Valanaar on the south side of Zephras Isle
Board the skyship at the dock with Alliance and Kirin Tor banners (to Dalaran)
In Dalaran, take the Stormwind portal in the Violet Citadel
Arrive in the Stormwind Mage Tower
Take the Deeprun Tram from the Dwarven District to Ironforge

guides.name: What is WoW: Forever?
guides.summary: A reboot of vanilla World of Warcraft with modern graphics, quality-of-life changes and new systems. The level cap is 60 and stays there for good: no expansions are planned.
steps: Reworked specialisations: three per class across nine classes
New zones: Zephras Isle, the Riverglades, Shen'dralas and Mount Hyjal
Nine new dungeons alongside the Classic ones
New raids: Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit, plus Onyxia's Lair
New factions: Azeroth Commerce Authority and Durotar Supply and Logistics (Merchant's Favor)
Black Market NPCs selling certain materials at fixed prices
The Legacy system: account-wide talent trees and rewards
Camping: campfires with buff and crafting objects
Updated graphics and weather, a Cooldown Manager and gamepad support

guides.name: Character names: rules
guides.summary: Every character needs a first and last name, and the pair must be unique across all rulesets in your region. Names are 2-12 characters with no spaces, numbers, symbols or punctuation.
steps: First and last name both required; the combination must be unique in your region
2-12 characters each; accented letters like ñ or ö are fine
No spaces, hyphens, numbers, symbols or apostrophes
No letter more than twice in a row; standard capitalisation
No slurs, obscenities, real politicians, Blizzard staff impersonation or major lore names (Thrall, Arthas, Sylvanas...)
Names can still be flagged later and force a rename
Roleplay realms: medieval/fantasy only, no famous references, one word
Pack owners could reserve up to 3 names before launch

guides.name: Playing with a controller
guides.summary: Forever supports gamepads for nearly everything, though a few menus still need a mouse. Turn on the Gamepad UI, then tune targeting and hotbars.
steps: Options → System → Gamepad (Alpha): tick Enable Gamepad UI (also under Gameplay in-game)
Lower back-pedal and run thresholds to about 0.3 for steadier running
Enable Show Input Prompts under Action Bars
Hold RB to target enemies or LB for friends, aim with the right stick
LB + RB + D-pad left/right switches action bar pages; hold LT/RT for other hotbar sets
Bind spells: Menu → Spellbook, highlight, press X, then the button; items: hover in bags, press Y, Bind
tips: Put frequent abilities on face buttons
Keep a separate page for buffs, food and utility
Leave Frame Focus Style on Gold

guides.name: Blessing of Zephras (fast travel on Zephras Isle)
guides.summary: Small tornadoes around Zephras Isle give the Blessing of the Zephras: +40% run speed for 5 minutes.
steps: Walk into a small tornado for the buff
Tornadoes don't always appear, even at their usual spots
It lasts 5 minutes and stays on in combat when you're hit
Any hostile action you take (attacks, spells, crowd control) ends it
tips: Plan routes between distant quests around the 5-minute buff

guides.name: Levelling 1-60: zone route
guides.summary: You level by questing, running dungeons, killing mobs near your level and exploring, with Rested XP and Well Fed food buffs speeding things up. Follow each zone's minimum level for the smoothest route.
route: 1: Elwynn Forest, Dun Morogh, Teldrassil, Zephras Isle (Skyborne), Durotar, Mulgore, Tirisfal Glades
10: Westfall, Loch Modan, Darkshore, The Barrens, Silverpine Forest
30: Alterac Mountains, Arathi Highlands, Desolace, Stranglethorn Vale
35: Badlands, Dustwallow Marsh, Feralas, Riverglades (new), Swamp of Sorrows
tips: Quest and fight near your level for the best XP
Keep a cooked-food Well Fed buff up: it now boosts XP
Log out in inns or cities for Rested XP
Visit class, weapon and riding trainers as you level
Dungeon enemies now give more XP

guides.name: Warrior levelling
guides.summary: All three specs can level: Arms is the classic pick for burst, Fury hits hard but takes more damage, and Protection can AoE packs with little health loss.
guides.talents: Arms: Deflection and Anger Management, skip Spearing Strike to max Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, then Bloodthrill (preferred) or Weaponmaster.
rotation: Rend if the mob will live a few ticks
Heroic Strike with leftover Rage (or Slam with Improved Slam)
keyGear: Whirlwind Axe / Sword / Warhammer: level 30 class quest
Brutal Hauberk or Fire Hardened Hauberk: level 20 class quest
Slow, heavy two-handers boost Whirlwind and Mortal Strike
Blacksmithing BoP gear
Health potions (now craftable with First Aid)
tips: Plan stance swaps so you don't waste Rage
Save some Rage from Execute for the next mob
Use Intimidating Shout, Retaliation and Shield Wall freely to pull more
Whirlwind is great for levelling in any spec
Blacksmithing + Mining

guides.name: Hunter levelling
guides.summary: Strong levellers thanks to pets, ranged damage and crowd control, though the first levels are slow. Beast Mastery is the smoothest; Marksmanship and Survival also work.
guides.talents: From level 10: Beast Mastery for pet damage and survival (Bestial Swiftness, Ferocity); Legacy points add Intimidation and Frenzy early.
rotation: Send the pet in while Auto Shooting
Summon Hawk on cooldown, Arcane Shot with two Hawks up
Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire on cooldown
If the pet loses aggro: Wing Clip, Concussive Shot or Frost Trap
keyGear: Barbaric Crossbow: Ragefire Chasm (13-16)
Calibrated Blunderbuss: Hall of Thanes quest, Alliance (13-16)
Venomstrike: Wailing Caverns (19-22)
Fallenroot Longbow: Blackfathom Deeps (23-29)
Master Hunter's Bow: Big Game Hunter quest (30)
tips: Summon pets at a campfire to give them Camping buffs
Feign Death to skip fights
Cheetah for travel, but getting hit dazes you
Pick up Skinning or Herbalism while you travel

guides.name: Mage levelling
guides.summary: Frost is the traditional levelling spec; Arcane and Fire work but lean on procs or dungeon groups.
guides.talents: From level 10. Frost: 7 points in Arcane for early Missile Barrage, then Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost. Arcane: rush Missile Barrage. Fire: Ignite, Incineration, Pyroblast.
rotation: Frostbolt as main spell (Rank 1 early to fish for Missile Barrage)
Ice Lance on frozen targets or Fingers of Frost
No procs: Frost Nova then Ice Lance
Packs: Frost Nova into Flamestrike and Arcane Explosion, or Blizzard
keyGear: Staff of Westfall: Deadmines
Nightskulker Ring: dungeons
Novice Arcanist's Sash and Spidersilk Boots: Tailoring
Manaweave Robe (Alliance) / Spellfire Robe (Horde): level 15 class quest
tips: Conjure a full stack of food and water between pulls
Use Lesser Wizard Oil for hard quests
Always keep mana for Blink and Frost Nova
Expect lots of drinking until Mage Armor at 34
Tailoring + Enchanting

guides.name: Paladin levelling
guides.summary: Slow but very safe: keep a Seal up and alternate Judgement and Holy Strike. Retribution, Protection or a Holy/Ret 'Shockadin' hybrid all work.
guides.talents: Mostly Retribution for the first 20-30 levels, starting at 10; the mid-level build uses 26 points, optionally skipping one 5th-row point for Repentance.
rotation: Seal of Command (Righteousness below 20 or with a one-hander)
Repeat Judgement and Holy Strike on cooldown
keyGear: Verigan's Fist: The Test of Righteousness (20)
Moonsilver Blade: The Moonsilver Blade (20)
Wolfsbane: Old Fire Eye quest
Cloak of the Divine Storm: Must be Delgren (22)
Bastion of Stormwind: Tome of Valor (20)
tips: Blacksmithing + Mining for spell power gear
Heal with Holy Light, using Divine Protection first if needed
Slow heavy weapons for Ret, fast ones for Protection's Seal of Fury
Greater Blessings aren't needed until raiding

guides.name: Priest levelling
guides.summary: Comfortable levelling by shielding, dotting and wanding. At 30 you settle into Discipline, Holy or (fastest) Shadow.
guides.talents: Builds are image-only on the source; the Legacy 'Talented' perk unlocks talents up to 5 levels early. Holy is not recommended for levelling (slow kills).
rotation: Power Word: Shield when mana allows
Discipline 30+: Penance for damage or healing
keyGear: Lesser Magic Wand (5) and Greater Magic Wand (13): Enchanting
Sizzle Stick: Wailing Caverns quest (15)
Gravestone Scepter: Blackfathom Deeps quest (18)
Wand of Eventide: world drop (27)
tips: Keep Power Word: Fortitude up
Spirit cuts drinking time
Shadow needs spell power to shine before 28

guides.name: Rogue levelling
guides.summary: Rogues got better Energy, stronger poisons and talent overhauls in every tree, with four levelling builds to choose from.
guides.talents: From level 10 pick Assassination, Combat, Subtlety Ambush or Subtlety Bleed; e.g. Remorseless Attacks at 10 (Assassination), Hack and Slash at 30 (Combat).
rotation: Backstab from Stealth with a dagger to burst
Only stealth for tough mobs: it slows levelling
keyGear: Shadowfang: Shadowfang Keep
Nightskulker Ring and Tunic of Westfall: dungeons
Dark Leather Boots and Brawler's Leather Belt: Leatherworking
tips: Skinning + Leatherworking
Poisons now stack with sharpening stones and Windfury Totem
Spend combo points before switching targets

guides.name: Shaman levelling
guides.summary: Great group assets with totems and Improved Ghost Wolf mobility. Enhancement is the smoothest levelling spec.
guides.talents: Separate Elemental, Enhancement and Restoration mid-level builds (to 30 with Legacy points, 35 without).
rotation: Lightning Shield, Windfury Weapon, Searing and Strength of Earth totems
Earth Shock filler; spend Maelstrom at 5 stacks
keyGear: Rage of the Storm / Lightning's Grasp / Tidebringer's Claw: level 30 Call of Air chain
Polished Driftwood Icon: Enchanting (BoP)
Totem of Charged Flames: Meddlesome Mages quest (Skyborne)
tips: Only drop totems you need
Earthbind to kite, Stoneclaw to pull aggro off you
Take Improved Ghost Wolf for instant indoor travel
Carry ankhs unless a Legacy talent removes reagents

guides.name: Warlock levelling
guides.summary: Affliction is the easiest start: let your demon tank while DoTs do the work, Life Tap and Drain Life for near-zero downtime.
guides.talents: Affliction: Improved Corruption, then Suppression; Unholy Power and Demonic Energies around 20; Improved Drains and Amplify Curse before 30; finish Affliction by 60.
rotation: Life Tap when health is higher than mana
keyGear: Staff or Orb of Soran'ruk: Warlock quest (fragments from Blackfathom Deeps and Shadowfang Keep)
Staff of the Shade: Razorfen Kraul (22+)
Gravestone Scepter: Blackfathom Villainy quest
Lesser / Greater Magic Wand: Enchanting
Shadow damage gear: Tailoring
tips: Fear a second mob while DoTs work on the first
Each Well Fed buff gives +5% kill XP
Keep a Healthstone
Never Curse of Recklessness a mob you plan to Fear

guides.name: Druid levelling
guides.summary: Feral cat is the smoothest route: early tools, Prowl and Dash, and little downtime for mana or healing.
guides.talents: Feral via the source's calculator build (skipping Shredding Attacks); later move Furor or bear points into DPS talents for dungeons.
rotation: Thorns up; Faerie Fire to pull
Ferocious Bite at 4-5 points with 70+ Energy
keyGear: Idol of Shifting Tides: Aquatic Form class quest
Wolfshead Helm: Leatherworking
Manual Crowd Pummeler: Gnomeregan
Embrace of the Viper set: Wailing Caverns
Polearms: trainable from level 20
tips: Use Innervate and Barkskin freely in the open world
Travel Form at 30, Teleport: Moonglade at 10
Drop out of form to heal or break roots

guides.name: Alchemy
guides.summary: Still the profession for elixirs, flasks and buffing consumables. New in Forever: portable Alchemy Laboratories (flasks no longer need Scholomance), dyes, new recipes such as Minor Arcane Elixir and Elixir of the Grizzly, and Healing Potions moved to First Aid.
tips: Pair with Herbalism, which supplies nearly every herb you need
Vials are sold by vendors in stacks of five, pricier each tier
Fishing supplies the odd fish used in some oils
Camp objects: Mana Well (mana regen), Fermenter and Alchemy Laboratory (workstations)
Legacy Working Overtime raises skill-up chance; Dedicated Study gives free points to your lowest profession

guides.name: Blacksmithing
guides.summary: Slow and material-hungry to level, but very rewarding at the top end. Forever overhauled the recipes, added hundreds of new plans (Merchant's Favor vendors and dungeon/raid drops), camp objects and a new crafting window, and stones now stack with poisons, enchants and totems.
tips: Pair with Mining for Copper Bars and Rough Stone
Most items need an anvil, but camp objects, weapon stones and most reagents can be made anywhere
Sharpening Stones and Weightstones stack with poisons, Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem
Recipe arrows: orange always skills up, yellow usually, green rarely
Trainers are in most settlements and every major city

guides.name: Enchanting
guides.summary: Still enhances gear, and now also makes spell power wands, weapons, relics, idols, totems and necklace enchants, sold through the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.
tips: Disenchant green-or-better gear for materials (destroys the item)
Material quality depends on item level
Runed Rods come from Blacksmithing
Tailoring pairs well: its early gear is great to disenchant
Fishing crates contain gear to disenchant and clams with pearls

guides.name: Engineering
guides.summary: Trades easy levelling and money for gadgets, bombs and consumable buffs. Forever adds child-proofed 'Saf-T' explosives anyone can throw, a Satchel of Copper Bombs, a Desolace-only foot pedal, Clanking Cord belts, and Reagent Bot, Repair Bot and Anarchist's Workbench camp objects.
tips: Keep the parts you make: low-level parts reappear in later recipes
The trainer teaches the Arclight Spanner, required for complex recipes
Mining supplies most materials; Alchemy suits some Forever recipes
Goblin/Gnomish specialisation needs 200 skill and a quest; switching means relevelling
Some top recipes need the Anarchist's Workbench camp object

guides.name: Tailoring
guides.summary: Makes cloth gear and bags, and its camp Faction Banner gives a Divine Spirit-style buff. Red Linen Bag now has 8 slots, new Linen and Woolen Reagent Bags were added, and new gear comes from Merchant's Favor vendors and low-level dungeon recipe drops.
tips: Disenchant early Tailoring gear for Enchanting or sell it for cloth money
Fishing crates contain bolts of cloth
Cloth must be made into bolts first; some recipes need the Spinning Wheel or Loom camp objects

guides.name: Leatherworking
guides.summary: Makes Leather and Mail armour, bags, quivers, reagent bags and armour kits. Forever keeps many Classic patterns and adds hundreds of new ones from 1 to 300, including enhanced Forceful and Mystic Rugged Armor Kits.
tips: Keep spare leather and hides: older materials come back in later recipes
A Salt Shaker turns Deeprock Salt into Refined Deeprock Salt every 3 days (for Cured Rugged Hides)
Pair with Skinning
The Camp Tent gives 5% of a level in Rested XP; Tanning Rack and Sewing Machine are workstations

guides.name: Mining
guides.summary: Classic pickaxe-and-Find-Minerals gathering, but ore respawns faster when more players are around, veins can hold more valuable minerals, and there are new bars such as Azerothium. Junior Mining Trainers in every starter zone (e.g. Kelsey Fargo in Northshire).
route: 1-70: Copper in every starting area (Poor Copper Veins from level 1); start Tin at 65
70-115: Tin and Copper (smelt Bronze) in Westfall, Silverpine, The Barrens, Loch Modan
115-175: Silver, Iron, Gold in Arathi Highlands, Alterac Mountains, Stranglethorn, Thousand Needles
175-230: Mithril in Badlands, Searing Gorge, Feralas, Tanaris, The Hinterlands
230-245: Dark Iron in Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes
245-275: Small Thorium in Winterspring, the Plaguelands, Feralas, Silithus, Un'Goro
275-300: Small and Rich Thorium; Azerothium Bar smelting from 275
tips: Keep Find Minerals on outside cities, and watch the minimap from flight paths
Rockslicer (Rhahk'Zor, Deadmines) mines Copper to Iron without the profession (30 uses)
Glove enchants, Miner's Cape and Goblin Mining Helm add skill
Camp objects: Lodestone (attack power), Rock Garden (spawns ore), Molten Foundry

guides.name: Herbalism
guides.summary: Gathers herbs mainly for Alchemy. Forever adds Scarce herbs, new herbs, seeds for your own camp Greenhouse, and the Incense Candle, Fermenter and Seed Hybridizer camp objects; First Aid now makes healing potions.
route: Level 20-30 zones: Bruiseweed, Wild Steelbloom, Kingsblood, Liferoot
Level 30-40 zones: Fadeleaf, Goldthorn, Khadgar's Whisker
Level 40-50 zones (Hinterlands best): Purple Lotus, Firebloom, Sungrass, Golden Sansam, Ghost Mushroom
Level 50-60 zones: Gromsblood, Dreamfoil, Mountain Silversage, Plaguebloom, Icecap, Black Lotus
tips: Goldthorn Tea gives +15 Herbalism
Legacy Bountiful Harvest boosts Scarce herbs
Earthroot grows on hills, Stranglekelp underwater, Ghost Mushroom in caves, Grave Moss by graves
Tauren Cultivation duplicates a herb

guides.name: Skinning
guides.summary: Collects leather, hides and scales for Leatherworking or the Auction House. Forever adds Fel and Pristine leathers and the Camp Chair (crit buff), Field Guide (track beasts) and Trapper's Workbench camp objects.
route: 75-115: Northern Barrens, Silverpine / Loch Modan, Darkshore, Westfall, Redridge
115-150: Southern Barrens, Wetlands, Hillsbrad, Ashenvale, Duskwood
150-205: Thousand Needles, Arathi, Desolace, Alterac, Stranglethorn, Riverglades, Dustwallow, Badlands
205-260: Feralas, Tanaris, Hinterlands, Searing Gorge, Azshara
260-300: Un'Goro, Blasted Lands, Felwood, Plaguelands, Winterspring, Silithus
tips: You only need a Skinning Knife in your bags
Train new ranks at 75, 125 and 200 skill
Skin while questing rather than making trips
Glove enchants and the Keen Skinning Knife add skill

guides.name: Cooking 1-300
guides.summary: Level Cooking mostly from fished and looted ingredients with cheap vendor recipes. Cooking makes campfires for the Camping system, and cooked food now gives a Well Fed XP bonus.
route: 50-100: Longjaw Mud Snapper (recipe in Ironforge or Thunder Bluff)
100-150: Bristle Whisker Catfish (Stormwind, Ratchet or Thunder Bluff)
150-175: buy Expert Cookbook (Ashenvale or Desolace), then Curiously Tasty Omelet with Raptor Eggs
225-250: Artisan via Clamlette Surprise quest in Tanaris, then Filet of Redgill (Booty Bay)
guides.trainers: Alliance: Alegorn (Darnassus), Daryl Riknussun (Ironforge), Stephen Ryback (Stormwind). Horde: Aska Mistrunner (Thunder Bluff), Eunice Burch (Undercity), Zamja (Orgrimmar).
tips: Level Fishing alongside Cooking
Use the 'Has skill up' filter
Gather Clamlette Surprise ingredients before taking the quest

guides.name: First Aid
guides.summary: Still makes bandages from cloth, and in Forever also makes instant, in-combat healing potions plus curatives for poison, disease and bleeds (the new curatives can't be used in combat).
tips: Healing potions need a vial, spices and Peacebloom, Briarthorn or Bruiseweed
Legacy Field Medicine speeds up bandaging
Pair with Herbalism

guides.name: Fishing
guides.summary: Close to Classic, plus Uncommon and Rare fish, Fish Bowl / Fishing Rack / Fishing Hut camp objects, a Chef's Knife for Unique Fish, a Bait and Tackle crafting menu, Fishing-skill food and a tournament where several players can win.
tips: Lures add temporary skill
Legacy talents Working Overtime, Luremaster and Dedicated Study help
Fish Bowl gives a Blessing of Kings-style buff
Pair with Cooking; wreckage also feeds Tailoring and Leatherworking

guides.name: PvP progression: Honor, ranks & seasons
guides.summary: PvP has two tracks. Honor is a currency from player kills, battlegrounds and PvP quests that you spend on gear; Rank Points come from battlegrounds and PvP quests and climb the 14 classic ranks each season (with a weekly cap). Your rank decides what you're allowed to buy.
route: Rank 8: epic bracers or belt upgrade token
Rank 12: epic legs or shoulders token
Rank 13: epic chest or helm token
Rank 14 (Grand Marshal / High Warlord): epic weapons
steps: Honor buys a blue PvP set and an epic set; each epic piece needs the blue piece plus an Emboldened Seal (rank-gated)
Higher ranks unlock cosmetic Elite versions of the PvP armour
Each season has a Field of Honor journey of weekly tasks giving Honor and Rank Points; weeks 4, 7 and 10 also give a Legacy Point
Honor rates were evened out across battlegrounds, so Alterac Valley isn't the only efficient choice
Holiday-week battlegrounds give bonus Honor and Rank Points
Shamans now have healer, melee and caster PvP sets
tips: Check your rank and what you can buy in the PvP tab of the character pane (C)
Plan Emboldened Seal rank requirements before buying epic pieces
Rank 14 needs 24,750 Rank Points in total (per early guides)

guides.name: Racial abilities (all races)
guides.summary: In Forever every race has two active and two passive racials. The old Classic weapon-specialisation and resistance passives are gone, several new racials were added, and Priests get extra race-specific spells. Skyborne racials differ by faction.
racials: Dwarf: Stoneform (defensive), Find Treasure (tracking), Artisan's Precision (hit chance), Big Game Hunter (bonus vs beasts)
Dwarf Priest: Chastise (root), Desperate Prayer (self-heal)
Gnome: Escape Artist, Eureka! (burst), Expansive Mind (bigger resource pool), Engineering Specialization
Gnome Priest: Confounding Flash (AoE crowd control), Contingency Plan (emergency heal)
Human: Will to Survive (PvP-trinket effect), Perception (see stealth), Ruthless (throughput), The Human Spirit (Spirit; healing for Holy Priests)
Human Priest: Divine Grace (re-shield sooner), Feedback (mana burn on attackers)
Night Elf: Elune's Light (crit burst), Shadowmeld, Quickness (dodge and speed), Wisp Spirit (faster resurrection)
Night Elf Priest: Elune's Grace (defensive), Starshards (extra DoT)
Skyborne High Order: Walk on Air (steerable slow fall), Read Ley Line (mana), Wind Blessed (haste), Elemental Insight (bonus vs elementals)
Orc: Blood Fury (burst), Shatter Curse (remove curses), Command (pet damage), Hardiness (stun resistance)
Tauren: War Stomp (AoE stun), Cultivation (duplicate herbs), Plainsrunning (speed), Endurance (health)
Troll: Berserking (haste burst), Rapid Regeneration, Beast Slaying, Regeneration
Troll Priest: Hex of Weakness, Shadowguard (thorns-like damage)
Undead: Will of the Forsaken, Cannibalize, Underwater Breathing, Touch of the Grave (damage and healing proc)
Undead Priest: Dark Sacrifice (health to mana), Touch of Weakness
Skyborne Windshaper: Walk on Air, Skysight (speed on foot and mounted), Wind Blessed, Elemental Insight

guides.name: Arcane Mage
guides.summary: Reworked into a proc-driven burst spec built around Arcane Blast stacks. Strong single-target damage, but mana-hungry and fragile, with no Ice Block.
rotation: Open with Arcane Blast to build stacks
Spend Arcane Concentration procs on Arcane Blast
Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage procs (from about 2 stacks)
Arcane Wrath at 3-4 stacks depending on mana
Fire Blast on cooldown to trigger Heating Up
Pyroblast at 3 Heating Up stacks with 3-4 Arcane Blast stacks
At 4 stacks: Arcane Power + Presence of Mind on big spells, then restart
guides.talents: Missile Barrage, Arcane Concentration, Arcane Meditation, Arcane Wrath, Arcane Mind and Arcane Power, dipping into Fire for Pyroblast and Heating Up.
bestRaces: Orc: Blood Fury spell power (top PvE pick)
Skyborne: haste + Read Ley Line mana
guides.forevChanges: Rebuilt into a competitive proc-based spec via Arcane Blast, Missile Barrage and Arcane Wrath.
tips: Watch mana closely after the third Arcane Blast stack
Save Evocation for long fights (pair with Read Ley Line on Skyborne)
Conjure a Mana Agate before every long fight
Kite with Frost Nova and line of sight

guides.name: Fire Mage
guides.summary: Crit-fuelled burst through Heating Up, Ignite and Fire Power, strong in dungeons and raids once geared. Weak while levelling, when low crit makes its mechanics unreliable.
rotation: Combustion for burst; Fire Blast on cooldown
Fireball, refreshing Scorch before it drops
guides.talents: Ignite, Pyroblast, Heating Up, Critical Mass, Fire Power and Combustion; a Frostfire variant takes Shatter and Fingers of Frost.
guides.forevChanges: New Heating Up makes Pyroblast usable in combat; Fire Power is now a stacking buff; Ignite was nerfed so Ignite-rolling is gone.
tips: Stack crit from gear and talents
Take Elemental Precision for dungeons and bosses
Burning Soul reduces spell pushback
Rely on Blink, kiting and crowd control: no Ice Block

guides.name: Frost Mage
guides.summary: Controls fights with slows and freezes, has the best survivability of the three Mage specs, and bursts frozen targets with Shatter. Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost make it a strong PvE spec now.
rotation: Keep Arcane Intellect and Ice Barrier up
Frost Armor solo, Mage Armor in groups
Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost procs
Frost Nova then Ice Lance when no proc
Cone of Cold to slow or reposition
guides.talents: Frost/Arcane sustained build with Arctic Reach, or a close-range Winter's Chill build; core picks are Shatter, Ice Shards, Fingers of Frost, Ice Lance, Ice Barrier and Arcane Meditation.
guides.forevChanges: Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost let Shatter work reliably on single targets without the old Frostbite/Frost Nova combo.
tips: Queue Ice Lance during Frostbolt when you expect a proc
Ice Barrier also boosts Frost damage
Take Frost Channeling and Arcane Meditation for mana
Use terrain to make slowed enemies path around you

guides.name: Holy Paladin
guides.summary: A direct healer with big cast-time heals and bursty crits but no HoTs or shields. Reactive healing backed by great group utility and personal survivability.
rotation: Keep Seal of Wisdom on the target
Holy Shock when someone may die before a cast lands, or while moving
Holy Light on heavy damage, started early
Holy Light on Infusion of Light procs
Flash of Light for lighter damage
guides.talents: Reverence, Illumination, Divine Favor, Holy Shock and Light's Vigil (the only AoE heal).
bestRaces: Undead: the only Horde Paladin race
guides.forevChanges: New Reverence talent lets Spirit regenerate mana in combat; Paladins have limited race choices (Horde: Undead only).
tips: Salvation on everyone but tanks
Blessing of Protection on anyone pulling threat
Blessing of Freedom on rooted players
Divine Intervention a distant healer to save a wipe
Lay on Hands drains all your mana

guides.name: Protection Paladin
guides.summary: A spell-powered tank mixing melee with Consecration, Judgement and Holy Shield, with Blessings and bubbles for the group. Excellent AoE threat, but low mobility and mana pressure in long single-target fights.
statPriority: Spell Power (most of the kit scales with it)
rotation: Seal of the Crusader before the pull, open with Judgement
Judgement and Swift Judgement on cooldown
guides.talents: Mana sustain through Shield Specialization, block and defensive talents, threat talents and extra taunts.
guides.forevChanges: Forever-only tools: Templar's Bulwark, Swift Judgement and Iron Creed, plus Legacy talent points.
tips: Seal of Wisdom on the boss helps everyone's mana
Salvation on non-tanks out of combat
Blessing of Sacrifice on targets taking many small hits

guides.name: Retribution Paladin
guides.summary: Heavy-armoured melee burst with slow, powerful swings and some spellcasting. Good survivability and group utility, but limited by mana.
statPriority: Intellect / Spell Power (Champion of the Light converts Intellect)
rotation: Seal of the Crusader before the pull
Open with Judgement of the Crusader
With Twist of Light, run Command and Righteousness together
guides.talents: Benediction, Sanctified Judgement, Holy Conduit, Sacred Arbiter, Champion of the Light, Instrument of Law (Hammer of Wrath in PvE) and Twist of Light (two Seals at once).
guides.forevChanges: New Twist of Light (two Seals), Sacred Arbiter and Instrument of Law.
tips: Use a slow, heavy two-hander
Divine Shield beats Divine Protection since you can keep attacking
Blacksmithing gives early Mail and Plate spell power gear

guides.name: Discipline Priest
guides.summary: Shields and heals, excelling at tank healing, and brings one of the best buffs in the game with Power Infusion. Weaker at spread-out group healing and has little mobility.
rotation: Power Word: Shield on tank, casters or yourself
Greater Heal + Inner Focus for big hits
guides.talents: 31/20/0 with Meditation, Soul Warding, Penance and Power Infusion.
bestRaces: Human: Divine Grace removes Weakened Soul
guides.forevChanges: Meditation buffed to 50% casting regen; mouseover casting is built in; new priest-friendly Tailoring, Enchanting and Engineering recipes.
tips: Pair Inner Focus with big heals
Fade before threat gets out of hand
Enable mouseover casting in Combat options

guides.name: Holy Priest
guides.summary: A versatile raid healer with a tool for every situation but almost no movement abilities.
rotation: Spread Renew across targets taking steady damage
Power Word: Shield to stop pushback and pre-shield
Greater Heal + Inner Focus for big hits
guides.talents: 18/33/0: Improved Renew, Holy Binding, Spiritual Guidance, Litany of Light, Spiritual Healing, Prayer of Mending and Meditation.
guides.forevChanges: Holy Binding makes Flash Heal heal you for half; new Litany of Light helps mana; Meditation buffed.
tips: Vary your spells to save mana
Use click-casting or mouseover
Library Books unlock the Philanthropist's Ring

guides.name: Shadow Priest
guides.summary: Shadow damage through DoTs, Mind Blast and Mind Flay, while Vampiric Embrace passively heals the group.
rotation: Fill with Mind Flay, letting it finish
guides.talents: 14/3/34: Mind Flay, Improved Mind Flay, Vampiric Embrace, Shadow Weaving and Shadowform; Silence now doubles as an interrupt.
guides.forevChanges: New Devouring Contagion spreads Devouring Plague; Improved Mind Flay and Silence reworked.
tips: Finish every Mind Flay: the last tick hits hardest
Leave Shadowform to heal
Get the Gravestone Scepter wand from Blackfathom Deeps

guides.name: Assassination Rogue
guides.summary: Dagger-and-poison specialist, now much stronger with Mutilate and Venom. High damage but juggles Slice and Dice, Venom and Expose Armor.
statPriority: Attack Power (poisons scale with it now)
rotation: Build with Mutilate (Sinister Strike at 4 points)
Expose Armor at 5 points on bosses
Eviscerate (or Kidney Shot) with spare points
guides.talents: Malice, Ruthlessness, Relentless Strikes, Improved Slice and Dice, Improved Poisons, Vile Poisons, Seal Fate and Venom; Precision for raids.
guides.forevChanges: New Mutilate and Venom; poisons can crit and scale with AP; Improved Expose Armor is cheaper and refunds combo points.
tips: Instant Poison on slow weapons, Deadly on fast
Don't switch targets mid-combo
Rogues have no AoE: kill packs one at a time

guides.name: Combat Rogue
guides.summary: Fights head-on with strong auto-attacks and burst, and is the only Rogue spec with real cleave (Blade Flurry). Very gear- and weapon-dependent.
rotation: Open with Ambush (daggers) or Garrote / Cheap Shot
Shank on cooldown for Energy and Venom
Expose Armor in long fights, Eviscerate with leftovers
guides.talents: Malice, Improved Slice and Dice, Hack and Slash, Dual Wield Specialization, Blade Flurry, Flash of Steel and Adrenaline Rush; dagger and hybrid variants exist.
guides.forevChanges: Hack and Slash lets you use any weapon type; new Shank ability; smooth Energy regen; poisons crit and scale with AP; Restless Blades removed.
tips: Never swap targets mid-combo
Vanish can drop combat to reset a bad fight
Kick casters, Evasion when tanking

guides.name: Subtlety Rogue
guides.summary: Two playstyles: a Bleed build empowering Rupture and Garrote, or an Ambush build with big crit burst. Revamped and now competitive in PvE.
rotation: Ghostly Strike on cooldown (enables Ambush in combat)
Death Mark once Slice and Dice and Expose are up
Eviscerate leftovers; Vanish + Ambush; Preparation to reset
guides.talents: Ambush build: Opportunity, Master of Deception, Ghostly Strike, Death Mark. Bleed build adds Dirty Deeds and Blood Splatter. Both take Malice and Serrated Blades.
guides.forevChanges: Ambush usable in combat via Ghostly Strike; new Death Mark finisher stores damage and explodes after 6 sec.
tips: Bleeds ignore armour: great on armoured bosses
Slice and Dice is your strongest finisher
No AoE: one target at a time

guides.name: Elemental Shaman
guides.summary: Slow to start but strong single-target and AoE caster damage, plus raid-wide totems and lots of utility. Mana is the constant limit.
statPriority: Spirit (main mana regen stat in Forever)
rotation: Drop Searing Totem once in combat
Pull with Lava Burst, then Flame Shock
AoE: Magma Totem, Fire Nova on cooldown, Chain Lightning with spare mana
guides.talents: Elemental Focus (free casts), Trial By Fire (AoE), Lava Burst, Earthbound for kiting and Lightning Overload.
bestRaces: Orc: Blood Fury burst (top Horde pick)
guides.forevChanges: Totems are now raid-wide; Magma Totem and Fire Nova are separate spells; Call of the Elements, Totemic Projection and Totemic Recall; Ghost Wolf works indoors.
tips: Always spend Clearcasting procs
Carry mana potions
Coordinate totems with other Shamans
Take Mindfulness when you have spare points

guides.name: Enhancement Shaman
guides.summary: Big Windfury burst on a two-hander plus lots of group buffs and utility. Weapon-dependent, mana-hungry and fairly squishy; can tank early dungeons.
rotation: Keep Lightning Shield and Windfury (or Rockbiter) Weapon up
Open with Lightning Bolt, then Stormstrike on cooldown
Instant Lightning Bolt on Maelstrom stacks during the Stormstrike debuff
AoE: Magma Totem and Fire Nova
guides.talents: Improved Ghost Wolf, Mental Dexterity, Shamanistic Focus, Flurry, Stormstrike, Improved Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon.
guides.forevChanges: Maelstrom Weapon and easier Stormstrike make the rotation more engaging; totems are raid-wide; Call of the Elements drops all four totems at once.
tips: Keep upgrading your weapon
Manage mana with Shamanistic Focus and Mana Spring Totem
Place totems where the boss won't be pulled away from them
Tanking works early but lacks a true taunt

guides.name: Restoration Shaman
guides.summary: A straightforward healer for single-target and group healing, with strong totem buffs and mana regen. Forever adds Riptide, raid-wide totems and more mobility.
rotation: Chain Heal from a target near other injured players (ideally one with Riptide)
Healing Stream Totem when your water slot is free
Lesser Healing Wave for urgent heals
guides.talents: Mindfulness, Water Shield, Mana Tide Totem, Ancestral Healing, Tidal Mastery, Nature's Swiftness and Riptide.
guides.forevChanges: New Riptide (instant heal + HoT that boosts Chain Heal); totems are raid-wide; Ghost Wolf works indoors.
tips: Cast a heal, then Riptide right after for burst
Keep Chain Heal targets close together
Macro Nature's Swiftness with a heal
Place Mana Tide where other healers benefit

guides.name: Affliction Warlock
guides.summary: Spreads DoTs that tick while you cast fillers or move, building damage over long fights. Weak burst, very self-sufficient with Life Tap and drains.
rotation: Bane of Doom if 1+ minute left, otherwise Amplify Curse + Bane of Agony
Your assigned Curse (Elements for casters, Recklessness for melee)
Shadow Bolt only on instant Shadow Trance
Life Tap in gaps or while moving
Wrack as filler, breaking it to refresh DoTs
guides.talents: Level 60 raid build uses Wrack as filler; the SM/Ruin build keeps Shadow Bolt and suits dungeons where you move a lot.
guides.forevChanges: DoTs can crit; Curses and Banes are separate; new Pandemic and Wrack talents; Life Tap scales with Spirit.
tips: Refresh DoTs right as they expire
Stack cooldowns in the 15 sec before Doom explodes
Skip DoTs on mobs about to die
Bind demon Attack/Follow to easy keys

guides.name: Demonology Warlock
guides.summary: Sacrifice one demon for its power while fighting with another, then build around Fire or Shadow. Both versions are within about 3% of each other, and the spec is sturdy thanks to Soul Link.
statPriority: Spell Power / your school (Fire or Shadow)
rotation: Fire build: Searing Pain when Demonic Brand is missing
Bane of Doom (1+ min) or Bane of Agony
Soul Fire during Decimation (Shadow Bolt for the Shadow build)
guides.talents: 2/31/18 for both: Demonic Pact, Demonic Knowledge, Demonic Brand and Decimation; Fire favours Immolate talents, Shadow takes Improved Shadow Bolt.
bestRaces: Orc: demon damage + Blood Fury (best fit)
guides.forevChanges: Demonic Pact keeps the sacrifice bonus with a demon out; demons scale with your gear; Demonic Brand feeds your pet; Decimation adds an execute phase.
tips: Play the Fire build in dungeons
Aim to finish fights with an empty mana bar
Boss AoE only half-hits demons
Skip Hellfire on two targets

guides.name: Destruction Warlock
guides.summary: Fire and Shadow burst and AoE: keep Immolate and DoTs up, fire Conflagrate and Shadowburn on cooldown, fill with Incinerate.
rotation: Bane of Doom (1+ min) or Amplify Curse + Bane of Agony
Conflagrate on cooldown while Immolate is up
Shadowburn on cooldown with a Soul Shard
guides.talents: Best raid option is the Sayaad build (14/4/33); Imp and Demonic Sacrifice alternatives exist.
guides.forevChanges: Incinerate is the new filler; Shadow and Flame lets Conflagrate and Shadowburn go on cooldown; new Bane of Havoc for cleave; Life Tap scales with Spirit.
tips: Use Conflagrate and Shadowburn as soon as ready
Two targets: Bane of Havoc on the second, skip Hellfire
Hellfire only on 3+ mobs in dungeons

systems.overview: World of Warcraft: Forever is a permanent third version of WoW that sits alongside modern WoW and Classic. It takes the original 2004-era game as its base and reworks it with new zones, more than 1,000 new quests, nine new dungeons, a new playable race called the Skyborne, and rebalanced classes. The level cap is fixed at 60 for good, and Blizzard plans to grow the game with new content rather than new levels. Story-wise it is set in WoW's first year, before The Burning Crusade, and it favours slower, community-driven play over automatic matchmaking.
systems.price: Forever comes with a normal World of Warcraft subscription or Game Time, which also covers modern WoW. No separate box purchase is needed. The optional packs are the Skyborne Heroic Pack ($29.99: unlocks the Skyborne race and the Zephras Isle starting zone, plus early name reservation, a Cerulean Prideclaw mount, cosmetics, housing decor for modern WoW and 1 Invite-A-Friend code), the Skyborne Epic Pack ($59.99: everything in Heroic, plus beta access, 30 days of game time, an extra mount, a transmog set, pets, tabards and 3 invite codes in total) and the Warcraft Forever Collection ($79.99: everything in Epic, plus Warcraft III: Reforged with the Forsaken Kingdom campaign and figurine decor; sold for a limited time until 11 January 2027). A physical Collector's Edition was sold through the Blizzard Gear Store while stock lasted.
systems.levelCap: 60 (permanent; Blizzard does not plan to raise it)

rulesets.name: Normal
rulesets.desc: A PvE-focused ruleset where PvP is opt-in. You can make characters on both factions.

rulesets.name: PvP
rulesets.desc: World PvP is always on, so opposing players can attack you anywhere. Each account is locked to one faction on this ruleset.

rulesets.name: Roleplay
rulesets.desc: Stricter naming and conduct rules for immersive roleplay, with PvE rules.

rulesets.name: Roleplay PvP
rulesets.desc: Roleplay rules combined with always-on world PvP.

rulesets.name: Hardcore
rulesets.desc: A permadeath ruleset planned for the winter after launch, with no fixed date yet. Hardcore is closed off from the other rulesets. A character that dies can be moved to another ruleset, and Legacy progress can flow out of Hardcore but not back in.

skyborne.desc: The Skyborne (shen'dorei) are a new race descended from Highborne exiles who made a pact with the air spirits and built a civilization in Skywall, the elemental plane of air. The spirits have since vanished, and Skyborne society is now split. The race comes with new customization options, druid forms of its own, and HD models only at launch; SD models and SD druid forms are planned for early 2027.
factions: Windshaper Skyborne (Horde), who follow elemental traditions
High Order Skyborne (Alliance), who pursue their ancestors' arcane legacy
racials: Walk on Air (both): lets you drift down slowly for up to 10 seconds
Wind Blessed (both): +1% Haste to melee, ranged and spells
Elemental Insight (both): +5% damage against Elementals
Skysight (Windshaper): an Elemental Blessing that gives +10% run speed
Read Ley Line (High Order): using a ley line doubles health and mana regeneration
skyborne.startingZone: Zephras Isle (levels 1-12), an island that mixes classic Warcraft style with elemental architecture. Characters of other races can still visit it later.
skyborne.howToUnlock: Buy any Skyborne pack (Heroic $29.99, Epic $59.99, or the Warcraft Forever Collection $79.99). A subscription or Game Time alone does not unlock the race.

systems.name: Legacy System and Legacy Points
systems.desc: This replaces achievements. There are 65 account-wide challenges at launch, covering class levels 25/45/60, profession milestones, PvP, exploration, and dungeon and raid bosses, and each one awards 1 Legacy Point. Each character spends up to 16 points in its own perk trees (Professions, Adventure and Resourcefulness), and can respec at class trainers. One character can earn enough points alone, so leveling alts is optional. Your account-wide point total also unlocks cosmetics, such as the Spectral Bear mount, pet and tabard. Open the system with the Y key.

systems.name: Camping
systems.desc: Cooking turns a Cooking Fire into a shared campfire. Nearby players can each add one profession-made feature to it, up to three, five or ten depending on the campfire's tier. Sitting or crafting at the camp for a minute gives buffs that are versions of class buffs and do not stack with them. Most features need skill 20 in the profession, and high-end ones drop in dungeons and raids. On PvP rulesets, enemies can find your camp.

systems.name: Dual specialization
systems.desc: Class trainers teach it at level 40 for 50 gold. You can swap specs anywhere outside combat and battlegrounds, and respec costs drop over time.

systems.name: HD / SD graphics and experience presets
systems.desc: Each character can use the original (SD) or updated (HD) model, which changes only its look. When you start, you pick a Classic preset (SD models, classic UI, no quest markers or transmog) or an Enhanced preset (HD models, quest guidance, one-bag view, transmog). Every setting can be changed later. The engine adds global illumination, volumetric fog, and better water and shadows, and the minimum GPU is AMD GCN 1, NVIDIA Maxwell or Intel Skylake.

systems.name: Controller support
systems.desc: Gamepads can target, cast, loot and move through menus, and the launch notes describe this support as a functional beta. You still need a keyboard to chat.

systems.name: Mega-realms and layering
systems.desc: There are no traditional realms. Each region has one large world per ruleset. Layering handles crowding, and community reports of the official tech podcast say layers follow zones or groups of zones, and that joining a group asks you when to switch layers. At launch, queues were reported to be only a few minutes.

systems.name: Collections
systems.desc: Mounts, pets, toys and transmog appearances are stored in an account-wide collection interface instead of your bags, and they are shared across rulesets.

systems.name: Names with surnames
systems.desc: Every character has a first name and a surname. The full name must be unique within the region, not just on one server. Name filters check both parts together, and you can hide surnames on nameplates.

systems.name: Auction houses (including Blackwater)
systems.desc: The Auction House uses the modern WoW interface. Markets are separate for each region and ruleset, and Blizzard calls linking rulesets a last resort. Community testing suggests each ruleset has three markets: Alliance, Horde, and a neutral one called Blackwater, which is probably found in the goblin towns. Blizzard has not officially confirmed the details of the neutral house.

systems.name: Black Market (Powderfuse Port)
systems.desc: Goblin traders in Powderfuse Port, in the Riverglades, run a bid-only auction for rare items such as cosmetics, Tier 0 pieces and the Deathcharger's Reins. They also sell some rare materials at fixed prices. These details are based on beta reports.

systems.name: Discord integration
systems.desc: You can link your Discord and Battle.net accounts and mirror guild chat both ways. This works in Forever and in modern WoW.

systems.name: Professions and supply factions
systems.desc: Characters can learn two primary professions plus Cooking, First Aid and Fishing. Many recipes come from the Azeroth Commerce Authority and Durotar Supply and Logistics, which return from Season of Discovery.

systems.name: PvP progression
systems.desc: PvP progression uses two currencies, Honor and Rank Points, with gear sets and seasonal weekly objectives. Forever adds a new 15v15 battleground, Battle for the Darkspear Islands.

systems.name: Cooldown Manager and Damage Meter
systems.desc: Built-in, optional UI tools under the advanced options. They replace some common addons.

systems.name: Temporary Economy Holds
systems.desc: Accounts suspected of real-money trading can be temporarily blocked from trade, mail, guild banks and the Auction House while Blizzard investigates. A hold is not a permanent strike.

systems.name: Season of Discovery carry-overs
systems.desc: Several features return from Season of Discovery: the Cozy Sleeping Bag, the Chronoboon Displacer, library books for every class, comprehension scrolls, and Tarnished Undermine Reals, which you trade in Booty Bay.

roadmap.what: Announced at BlizzCon. Pre-purchase packs go on sale.
Open stress test for all players. Characters were wiped afterwards.
Early name reservation for pack owners.
First post-launch class tuning (Hunter pets, Voidwalkers, Affliction, Enhancement).
Pouch of Violet Dust Twitch drop and the launch celebration end.
Raids open: Barrow Deeps (10), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40).
SD Skyborne models and SD druid forms.
Warcraft Forever Collection is no longer sold.
Two new raids, two new dungeons, new quests and a new zone, a legendary questline, and a PvP season refresh.
A revamped iconic raid plus one new raid, more world content, two new dungeons, a PvP season refresh, and updates to professions and Legacy.

faq.q: Do I need to buy Forever?
faq.a: No. A WoW subscription or Game Time covers it. You only need a paid pack to play the Skyborne race.

faq.q: Will the level cap ever go above 60?
faq.a: Blizzard says no. New content will come as raids, dungeons, zones and quests at level 60.

faq.q: Can I play with friends on another ruleset or faction?
faq.a: Grouping, guilds, dungeons and raids only work within the same ruleset and faction. Battlegrounds can mix rulesets, except Hardcore.

faq.q: Can I move a character to another ruleset?
faq.a: Not freely. You need a new character for each ruleset. The one exception is that a Hardcore character can move out after it dies.

faq.q: Is progress shared across my account?
faq.a: Yes for collections and Legacy Points. Gold, bags and reputation appear to stay with each character.

faq.q: Is this the same as Classic Era?
faq.a: No. Forever is a separate game version with new zones, a new race, reworked classes and talents, new systems such as Legacy and Camping, and optional modern conveniences.
On 9 December 2026: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair.

faq.q: Can I play on a controller or a Mac?
faq.a: Yes. Forever runs on Windows and macOS, and gamepad support is available but still labelled beta.
Not yet. It is planned for the winter after launch.
